     1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""Single-Support ReID — cheap kill-switch (零训练).
     3	
     4	codex 训练侧 #1: 训练时每 ID 只用单图 support 定义身份, 对 worst-support 选择做 CVaR 优化。

     6	非 test-time/检索侧/范式重定义。
     7	
     8	kill-switch(零训练): 每 gallery ID 只留 1 图, 报 mAP:
     9	  - full-gallery (每 ID 全图)        : baseline 上界
    10	  - random-support (每 ID 随机 1 图) : 随机单 support
    11	  - worst-support (每 ID 选最差 1 图) : CVaR worst-case 目标针对的
    12	  - best-support (每 ID 选最好 1 图)  : support 选择 oracle 上界
    13	
    14	GO(support 选择是真训练瓶颈, 值得 CVaR 优化):
    15	  worst 比 full 掉 > 3 mAP  AND  best - worst gap > 3 mAP (support 选择 matters)。
    16	DEAD: best≈worst (哪张 support 都一样, 没 support 选择价值) 或 single≈full (单图够)。
    17	
    18	复用 Market 特征 cache (/tmp/ae_feats.npz, frozen SOLIDER exp260b)。
    19	Run on lab-3090-d: cd repo && python experiments/exp367_single_support/cvpb_single_support_probe.py
    20	"""
    21	import numpy as np
    22	from collections import defaultdict
    23	import argparse
    24	
    25	ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    26	ap.add_argument('--cache', default='/tmp/ae_feats.npz')
    27	cli = ap.parse_args()
    28	
    29	z = np.load(cli.cache)
    30	qf, qp, qc = z['qf'], z['qp'], z['qc']
    31	gf, gp, gc = z['gf'], z['gp'], z['gc']
    32	print(f'[single-support] q={len(qf)} g={len(gf)} ids={len(set(gp))}', flush=True)
    33	
    34	
    35	def eval_gallery(g_idx):
    36	    """标准 Market mAP: gallery 只用 g_idx, 排同 cam 同 id。"""
    37	    gff, gpp, gcc = gf[g_idx], gp[g_idx], gc[g_idx]
    38	    sim = qf @ gff.T
    39	    aps, r1s = [], []
    40	    for i in range(len(qf)):
    41	        keep = ~((gpp == qp[i]) & (gcc == qc[i]))
    42	        s = sim[i][keep]; gpk = gpp[keep]
    43	        if len(s) == 0: continue
    44	        o = np.argsort(-s); m = (gpk[o] == qp[i])
    45	        if not m.any(): continue
    46	        cum = np.cumsum(m); r = np.arange(1, len(m) + 1)
    47	        aps.append((cum[m] / r[m]).mean()); r1s.append(float(m[0]))
    48	    return 100*np.mean(aps), 100*np.mean(r1s)
    49	
    50	
    51	id2g = defaultdict(list)
    52	for i, p in enumerate(gp): id2g[p].append(i)
    53	
    54	# full-gallery
    55	full_mAP, full_R1 = eval_gallery(np.arange(len(gf)))
    56	
    57	# random-support: 每 ID 随机 1 图
    58	rng = np.random.RandomState(42)
    59	rand_idx = np.array([rng.choice(v) for v in id2g.values()])
    60	rand_mAP, rand_R1 = eval_gallery(rand_idx)
    61	
    62	# best/worst-support: 每 ID 选 single-support 使该 ID 的"被同 ID query 检索质量"最高/最低
    63	# 用 该 ID 的 gallery 图 与 该 ID 所有 query 的平均 sim 作为 support quality (高=好 support)
    64	best_idx, worst_idx = [], []
    65	for p, gidxs in id2g.items():
    66	    q_same = np.where(qp == p)[0]
    67	    if len(q_same) == 0:
    68	        best_idx.append(gidxs[0]); worst_idx.append(gidxs[0]); continue
    69	    # 每个候选 support 图 g 对 同 ID query 的平均 cos (排同 cam)
    70	    quality = []
    71	    for g in gidxs:
    72	        qs = q_same[qc[q_same] != gc[g]]                   # 排同 cam
    73	        quality.append((qf[qs] @ gf[g]).mean() if len(qs) else -1.0)
    74	    quality = np.array(quality)
    75	    best_idx.append(gidxs[int(np.argmax(quality))])
    76	    worst_idx.append(gidxs[int(np.argmin(quality))])
    77	best_mAP, best_R1 = eval_gallery(np.array(best_idx))
    78	worst_mAP, worst_R1 = eval_gallery(np.array(worst_idx))
    79	
    80	print(f'\n[SINGLE-SUPPORT RESULT]')
    81	print(f'  full-gallery     : mAP={full_mAP:.2f} R1={full_R1:.2f}')
    82	print(f'  best-support     : mAP={best_mAP:.2f} R1={best_R1:.2f}  (vs full {best_mAP-full_mAP:+.2f})')
    83	print(f'  random-support   : mAP={rand_mAP:.2f} R1={rand_R1:.2f}  (vs full {rand_mAP-full_mAP:+.2f})')
    84	print(f'  worst-support    : mAP={worst_mAP:.2f} R1={worst_R1:.2f}  (vs full {worst_mAP-full_mAP:+.2f})')
    85	print(f'  worst-vs-full drop = {full_mAP-worst_mAP:.2f} (GO>3)  best-worst gap = {best_mAP-worst_mAP:.2f} (GO>3)')
    86	go = (full_mAP - worst_mAP) > 3.0 and (best_mAP - worst_mAP) > 3.0
    87	print(f'  [verdict] {"GO (support 选择是真训练瓶颈, 值得 CVaR worst-support 优化)" if go else "DEAD (support 选择无价值, best≈worst 或单图够)"}')
    88	print('[done]', flush=True)

experiments/decisions.md:4691:**上下文**: 三个独立 codex(终身 d3 / 开集 d9 / 长尾 d10)收敛到同一 re-framing: ReID 失败由 GALLERY 组成(规模/膨胀/分布)驱动, 非只看 query/模型。用户要求零训练验证, ★铁律=每个 per-query 相关都控 trivial 代理(吸取 HUBNESS §7.6 教训: 上个诊断被漏控 #false-in-topk 证伪)。脚本 `cvpb_gallery_killswitch.py`, 复用 hubness 缓存特征, Market exp260b + Occluded-Duke exp255。双审(Claude broad 5 blocking 全修 + Codex)。
experiments/decisions.md:4694:- **测试 A Gallery-Growth Tax = LIVE**: frozen 模型旧 query mAP 随同域 gallery 膨胀结构性下降(Market 1x→10x −4.4, **OD −12.9**, 量级≈LReID 报的 forgetting)。CONTROL1(#false-in-topk, 杀 Hubness 的代理): ρ(−dAP,d#false)+0.74 大部分是 trivial 计数, 但"#false 完全不变"子集仍 −1.2(Market)/−2.6(OD) mAP, partial(OD)+0.28——结构成分过了致命代理。CONTROL2 ★决定性: real distractor −4.45(Market)/−13.16(OD) vs 列洗牌毁方向同 count −0.00 → tax 是结构性(distractor 身份几何咬人), 非机械 count。
experiments/decisions.md:4696:- **测试 C Singleton Merge = DEAD**: NN-is-head 0.72 只反映 head 占 72% 图像质量。per-head-ID(n=450/311 真功效)Spearman(support, attraction-PER-IMAGE)+0.003/+0.005≈0, 分箱 per-image 甚至下降。support-calibrated 阈值几乎无增益(d≈−0.003)且 40-60% level 退回 global。被 "head 图多→NN 彩票多" trivial count 吃掉。
experiments/decisions.md:4699:**理由**: A 是唯一过了 #false-in-topk + 列洗牌双控的信号, headline 干净: "frozen 强 ReID 旧 query 随同域 gallery 膨胀结构性掉点, LReID 误记为 catastrophic forgetting"。这正是上个 Hubness 诊断没做到的(被 trivial 代理吃光)——本次 A 的两个对照专为此教训设计且活下来。
experiments/decisions.md:4710:- **d17 rank-leverage KILL**: RLC 现象成立(mean 0.357>uniform 0.167)但 raw spearman 反向(−0.100)+partial|#false −0.049≈0 → 重演 Hubness/evidence #false-trivial-proxy 坑(本 session 第 N 次验证: 任何 per-query 解释变量必控 #false-in-topk)。
experiments/decisions.md:4711:- **codex meta-eval 确认探索充分收敛**: 全新范式(event-camera 5.5 需新数据/federated 4.5/text 3 撞 FM/3D-SMPL 2.5 撞 SMPL/group 2 撞#false)非当前代码线方法点。
experiments/decisions.md:4714:**理由**: 探索充分收敛——训练端无空间(8 机制+4 codex)/冲 7.0 机制范围被 detector 误差封顶/d17 撞 #false 坑/全新范式需新数据非方法点。6.5 是诚实天花板=中等偏强 B 类(重定义+干净 test-time 机制+训练端系统反例+多维证据+σ-sweep 诚实界定)。负结果大多成论文素材。
experiments/decisions.md:4724:- **open-set/gallery-growth(codex 核查)**: 3.5/10 主线(撞 gallery 死区 B/C/Hubness 都被 #false-in-topk 吃 + 先例卡紧 Open-set ReID 2014/Open-Set Biometrics 2024, 唯一窄缝是 LReID re-attribution 分析非新机制)。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:14:exp360 Intruder Identity Suppression 阶段0 frozen probe 结果, 帮判方向(调研/决策交你, 别捧场)。机制: 遮挡 ReID 重定义为 donor 行人身份污染 target embedding, 训练端对抗压 donor-ID, 测试单图。**阶段0 frozen 强 baseline(market) 合成 target+donor**: H1 donor-ID linear probe acc 73% vs chance 2% = **36.5x PASS(泄漏巨大确凿)**; person leak 0.15 >> rand patch -0.01 PASS; **但 H2 FAIL: leak=cos(f_mix,f_donor)-cos(f_clean,f_donor) vs per-query AP drop, raw spearman +0.120, 控 #false-in-topk(top-k混错ID平凡代理)后 partial=-0.028 约0**。AP drop 大(clean 0.835→mix 0.409)。诚实含义: donor 泄漏存在且大, 但泄漏量不独立于 #false 预测检索损害。问: (a)H2 FAIL 是否**致命否定** Intruder 因果链(压泄漏→救检索)? 还是 H2(frozen per-query 相关)≠H3(训练干预), donor suppression 训练仍值得试? (b)若值得试, 阶段1怎么设计让'压 donor-ID'真涨不退化成 target ambiguity 墙(KPR已占)? (c)若致命, 3候选回选下一个: B PSC-JEPA(从SOLIDER continued-pretrain pseudo-support-bank latent JEPA) / C-#3 support-set continued pretrain / 还是另起? 联网查 identity disentangle/feature purification/source separation occluded ReID 里'泄漏可测但压它未必涨'的先例教训(OGFR DPEFormer 等)。务实中文, 每选项信心1-10。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:814:experiments/decisions.md:4694:- **测试 A Gallery-Growth Tax = LIVE**: frozen 模型旧 query mAP 随同域 gallery 膨胀结构性下降(Market 1x→10x −4.4, **OD −12.9**, 量级≈LReID 报的 forgetting)。CONTROL1(#false-in-topk, 杀 Hubness 的代理): ρ(−dAP,d#false)+0.74 大部分是 trivial 计数, 但"#false 完全不变"子集仍 −1.2(Market)/−2.6(OD) mAP, partial(OD)+0.28——结构成分过了致命代理。CONTROL2 ★决定性: real distractor −4.45(Market)/−13.16(OD) vs 列洗牌毁方向同 count −0.00 → tax 是结构性(distractor 身份几何咬人), 非机械 count。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:815:experiments/decisions.md:4699:**理由**: A 是唯一过了 #false-in-topk + 列洗牌双控的信号, headline 干净: "frozen 强 ReID 旧 query 随同域 gallery 膨胀结构性掉点, LReID 误记为 catastrophic forgetting"。这正是上个 Hubness 诊断没做到的(被 trivial 代理吃光)——本次 A 的两个对照专为此教训设计且活下来。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:903:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20.sh:6:CTX="一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。"
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:972:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:14:一个 ReID 团队的 **Lattice-Marginalized ReID**(重定义: 低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性, 非'模糊缺细节')零训练 kill-switch = GO。证据: frozen 模型, K=9 phase/bbox/kernel variants 的 ensemble 在 h=16 LR query 上 +4.23 mAP, **比同 K 的普通随机 TTA 多 +3.04**(lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名: lat-MaxSim 46.9>tta 43.8>single 42.6), 74.9% LR query 跨 lattice 变体翻转 rank-1 身份(h升→31%→10%), 过 vs-TTA + vs-#false 双控。**诚实: phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器与 LR-severity 共线(correlational 弱), GO 靠 interventional ensemble 结果(直接测量)。**

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1023:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4632:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:8892:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:43:We tested the obvious remedies and report them honestly. A zero-training hub penalty `score' = cos − λ·log(1+H_k)` gives only +0.31 (Market) / +1.51 (Occluded-Duke) mAP, and is **dominated** by same-camera down-weighting (+0.67 / +3.13) and k-reciprocal (+1.26 / **+10.98**)—the gap *widens* on the harder set. A training-side anti-hub embedding sits in the same space already covered by re-ranking. The mechanism (scene over-encoding) points to background/region suppression, which is non-generalizable here (a dataset-specific scene) and overlaps prior pose-masked suppression. We therefore present negative in-degree as a **diagnostic**: it tells you *where* strong ReID fails and *why* (gallery topology / non-identity factor), while the *fix* remains the province of established test-time tools.
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1024:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4651:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:9441:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/video_feasibility.md:275:一个 ReID 团队连续 4 个 frozen-image 方向被零训练 kill-switch 干净否掉(B 航拍不确定性包含=前提错 / GOPL SMPL正样本可靠性=occlusion-count廉价代理 / Gallery Hubness=诊断真但remedy被k-reciprocal完全占 / OSAC谱过坍缩=前提倒置训练反而升rank)。**frozen-image-retrieval 的隐藏变量都被成熟 test-time 工具(k-reciprocal/camera-aware re-ranking)碾压或证伪, 这条路穷尽。** 唯一真发现=gallery 负向 in-degree hubness(M(q) 解释 AP 误差 rho+0.60, analysis 级非方法)。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1042:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4833:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:14585:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5544:reassess/r_3.md:5131:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp324b/_codex_review2.log:2647:./experiments/exp324b/claude_review.md:12:不是。exp324 frozen 已通过 kill-switch（重遮挡 pose part-MaxSim 1.86 mAP，×3.4 超整图 0.55，且均匀网格对照只 0.67 几乎不涨 → 涨点来自"姿态锚定"机制本身）。exp324b 是这个正信号的**自然下一步**：在冻结特征上训最小投影头，验证"冻结 FM 特征能否被轻量头拉到可用 ReID 判别空间"。单变量隔离干净（baseline = exp324 frozen 同 pipeline，只多了一个 413K 线性头 + BNNeck + 分类器）。这是范式/参数角度的合法探索，不属于禁止回退方向（不是 visibility 小改、不是 retrieval-side scorer 微变体、不是 test-time trick）。重点应放在实现正确性，下文逐行审。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1099:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:5168:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_1.txt:10:廉价 kill-switch：零训练先做三件事。下载 VeRi-776 或 VERI-Wild annotations，用 frozen Swin/CLIP/DINO/已有 ReID checkpoint 跑 seen/unseen type split；统计 top-k false positives 中同 model/color/type 的比例；再做一个 test-time 语义原型惩罚或 subtraction。如果 unseen mAP 没有明显改善，或错误不集中在同车型同色假阳性，直接杀。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1127:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:7569:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:1886:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:14:一个 ReID 团队的 **Lattice-Marginalized ReID**(重定义: 低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性, 非'模糊缺细节')零训练 kill-switch = GO。证据: frozen 模型, K=9 phase/bbox/kernel variants 的 ensemble 在 h=16 LR query 上 +4.23 mAP, **比同 K 的普通随机 TTA 多 +3.04**(lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名: lat-MaxSim 46.9>tta 43.8>single 42.6), 74.9% LR query 跨 lattice 变体翻转 rank-1 身份(h升→31%→10%), 过 vs-TTA + vs-#false 双控。**诚实: phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器与 LR-severity 共线(correlational 弱), GO 靠 interventional ensemble 结果(直接测量)。**
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1132:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:8085:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:14:一个 ReID 团队的 **Lattice-Marginalized ReID**(重定义: 低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性, 非'模糊缺细节')零训练 kill-switch = GO。证据: frozen 模型, K=9 phase/bbox/kernel variants 的 ensemble 在 h=16 LR query 上 +4.23 mAP, **比同 K 的普通随机 TTA 多 +3.04**(lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名: lat-MaxSim 46.9>tta 43.8>single 42.6), 74.9% LR query 跨 lattice 变体翻转 rank-1 身份(h升→31%→10%), 过 vs-TTA + vs-#false 双控。**诚实: phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器与 LR-severity 共线(correlational 弱), GO 靠 interventional ensemble 结果(直接测量)。**
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1200:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:3963:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:4730:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10916:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:11752:从 Market/Occluded-Duke 中选高可见 target query `T` 和 donor 行人 `D`，把 donor 的人体 mask 或 bbox 贴到 `T` 上，生成 `M=T⊕D`。gallery 保持原始，里面同时有 target-ID 和 donor-ID。这样 donor 身份、target 身份、遮挡 mask 全部已知，但 eval 仍按 target pid 算。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1609:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3622:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5546:reassess/r_3.md:5139:本地 exp109 的原始记录比当前叙述更细：oracle support bank 上界是强阳性，但它用 GT same-ID prototype，是“知道目标身份以后怎么补”的上界；这正是 donor-source-separation 必须绕开的墙。真正的 kill-switch 不能只测“泄漏能不能被检测”，必须在 frozen 特征上直接测“无 GT 身份、只按遮挡源压制后，排序是否上升”。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1748:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:1195:experiments/decisions.md:4694:- **测试 A Gallery-Growth Tax = LIVE**: frozen 模型旧 query mAP 随同域 gallery 膨胀结构性下降(Market 1x→10x −4.4, **OD −12.9**, 量级≈LReID 报的 forgetting)。CONTROL1(#false-in-topk, 杀 Hubness 的代理): ρ(−dAP,d#false)+0.74 大部分是 trivial 计数, 但"#false 完全不变"子集仍 −1.2(Market)/−2.6(OD) mAP, partial(OD)+0.28——结构成分过了致命代理。CONTROL2 ★决定性: real distractor −4.45(Market)/−13.16(OD) vs 列洗牌毁方向同 count −0.00 → tax 是结构性(distractor 身份几何咬人), 非机械 count。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1749:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:1196:experiments/decisions.md:4699:**理由**: A 是唯一过了 #false-in-topk + 列洗牌双控的信号, headline 干净: "frozen 强 ReID 旧 query 随同域 gallery 膨胀结构性掉点, LReID 误记为 catastrophic forgetting"。这正是上个 Hubness 诊断没做到的(被 trivial 代理吃光)——本次 A 的两个对照专为此教训设计且活下来。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:2328:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:15444:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:6406:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:5139:本地 exp109 的原始记录比当前叙述更细：oracle support bank 上界是强阳性，但它用 GT same-ID prototype，是“知道目标身份以后怎么补”的上界；这正是 donor-source-separation 必须绕开的墙。真正的 kill-switch 不能只测“泄漏能不能被检测”，必须在 frozen 特征上直接测“无 GT 身份、只按遮挡源压制后，排序是否上升”。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:2509:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:15641:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:6955:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14:ReID 范式转向终局决策(调研交给你, 不判死, 帮选+审视可行性)。3 路 gap analysis 收敛: 遮挡 ReID 根问题=single-image support incomplete(项目 exp109 oracle 证 +8.5 mAP headroom)。两个最强候选二选一去 build: **#1 T-SCD(Temporal Support-Complete Distillation, 7.5/10)**: 训练用 occluded_posetrack tracklet(同 ID 多帧)构 support-complete teacher 蒸馏进单图 student, 测试单图。**#2 Intruder Identity Suppression(6.8/10)**: 遮挡重定义为另一行人身份泄漏进 target embedding, 训练合成 target+donor 显式压 donor-ID(GRL/adversarial)+clean-occluded consistency。**关键审视**: 项目 memory 记 exp109 的 +8.5 oracle headroom 是'identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙'(测试时不知 ID 没法 complete support; 三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/95.8%可见; 当年结论'别在 ReID 内部找机制')。问: (a)T-SCD 把 identity-conditioned support 放训练端(tracklet privileged info)蒸馏进单图 student, 是真绕过 exp109 测试端墙, 还是又撞同一堵墙(privileged distillation gap/student 学不会)? 诚实判断别捧场。(b)T-SCD vs Intruder 哪个更值得 build(野心×可行×novelty×B类×绕开项目死区)? (c)选定方向的最终 pipeline + 头号风险 + 头号 kill-switch(第一周能看的)。联网查 privileged/temporal distillation to single-image occluded ReID + identity source separation ReID 的 2024-26 novelty 先例。务实中文, 信心 1-10。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:2565:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:15697:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:7063:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:3924:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:18118:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:5124:./reassess/r_3.md:11738:先验很低，因为它已经撞到 FED 的 NTP feature contamination、KPR 的 multi-person ambiguity、QPM 的 target-pixel attention、DPEFormer 的 occlusion-free token selection，以及 TTPM 那条 non-target pedestrian occlusion/texture-aware 路线。能活下来的唯一差异是：**不讲“遮挡区域噪声”，只讲“遮挡者身份向量把 target embedding 拉向 donor-ID，并且可被无身份信息的 source separation 压掉后直接涨 ReID”。**

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:2606:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:15742:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:11555:ReID 范式转向终局决策(调研交给你, 不判死, 帮选+审视可行性)。3 路 gap analysis 收敛: 遮挡 ReID 根问题=single-image support incomplete(项目 exp109 oracle 证 +8.5 mAP headroom)。两个最强候选二选一去 build: **#1 T-SCD(Temporal Support-Complete Distillation, 7.5/10)**: 训练用 occluded_posetrack tracklet(同 ID 多帧)构 support-complete teacher 蒸馏进单图 student, 测试单图。**#2 Intruder Identity Suppression(6.8/10)**: 遮挡重定义为另一行人身份泄漏进 target embedding, 训练合成 target+donor 显式压 donor-ID(GRL/adversarial)+clean-occluded consistency。**关键审视**: 项目 memory 记 exp109 的 +8.5 oracle headroom 是'identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙'(测试时不知 ID 没法 complete support; 三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/95.8%可见; 当年结论'别在 ReID 内部找机制')。问: (a)T-SCD 把 identity-conditioned support 放训练端(tracklet privileged info)蒸馏进单图 student, 是真绕过 exp109 测试端墙, 还是又撞同一堵墙(privileged distillation gap/student 学不会)? 诚实判断别捧场。(b)T-SCD vs Intruder 哪个更值得 build(野心×可行×novelty×B类×绕开项目死区)? (c)选定方向的最终 pipeline + 头号风险 + 头号 kill-switch(第一周能看的)。联网查 privileged/temporal distillation to single-image occluded ReID + identity source separation ReID 的 2024-26 novelty 先例。务实中文, 信心 1-10。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:2957:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:16176:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10916:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:11752:从 Market/Occluded-Duke 中选高可见 target query `T` 和 donor 行人 `D`，把 donor 的人体 mask 或 bbox 贴到 `T` 上，生成 `M=T⊕D`。gallery 保持原始，里面同时有 target-ID 和 donor-ID。这样 donor 身份、target 身份、遮挡 mask 全部已知，但 eval 仍按 target pid 算。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:2958:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:16178:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10918:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:11789:先验很低，因为它已经撞到 FED 的 NTP feature contamination、KPR 的 multi-person ambiguity、QPM 的 target-pixel attention、DPEFormer 的 occlusion-free token selection，以及 TTPM 那条 non-target pedestrian occlusion/texture-aware 路线。能活下来的唯一差异是：**不讲“遮挡区域噪声”，只讲“遮挡者身份向量把 target embedding 拉向 donor-ID，并且可被无身份信息的 source separation 压掉后直接涨 ReID”。**
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:2959:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:16179:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10921:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:11803:从 Market/Occluded-Duke 中选高可见 target query `T` 和 donor 行人 `D`，把 donor 的人体 mask 或 bbox 贴到 `T` 上，生成 `M=T⊕D`。gallery 保持原始，里面同时有 target-ID 和 donor-ID。这样 donor 身份、target 身份、遮挡 mask 全部已知，但 eval 仍按 target pid 算。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:2960:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:16182:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17626:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/GOPL_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:38:- D4 不过(cov3d≈cov2d): GOPL 降级。转 p_3 遮挡 source-separation(donor-ID probe) 或 p_2 备选 SCEI(surface ACE)。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:2961:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:16183:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17863:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:953:./reassess.sh:19:ROLES[3]="角色=**遮挡最后一搏**。p_3提的遮挡source-separation(occlusion=别人身份污染target embedding, donor-ID泄漏)值不值得测? 但必须面对历史'occluder-gate是墙'(exp109: 即使gate掉遮挡, headroom是identity-conditioned不可实现)。设计**最锋利最便宜的kill-switch, 且必须同时回答'压制donor-ID泄漏能不能真涨ReID'**(不只是证泄漏存在——泄漏存在但压了不涨=撞墙=没用)。联网查novelty(撞TTPM/non-target-pedestrian-occlusion那批没)。如果连这都救不动或必撞墙, 诚实说'遮挡这块彻底关'。"

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3145:exp360 Intruder Identity Suppression 阶段0 frozen probe 结果, 帮判方向(调研/决策交你, 别捧场)。机制: 遮挡 ReID 重定义为 donor 行人身份污染 target embedding, 训练端对抗压 donor-ID, 测试单图。**阶段0 frozen 强 baseline(market) 合成 target+donor**: H1 donor-ID linear probe acc 73% vs chance 2% = **36.5x PASS(泄漏巨大确凿)**; person leak 0.15 >> rand patch -0.01 PASS; **但 H2 FAIL: leak=cos(f_mix,f_donor)-cos(f_clean,f_donor) vs per-query AP drop, raw spearman +0.120, 控 #false-in-topk(top-k混错ID平凡代理)后 partial=-0.028 约0**。AP drop 大(clean 0.835→mix 0.409)。诚实含义: donor 泄漏存在且大, 但泄漏量不独立于 #false 预测检索损害。问: (a)H2 FAIL 是否**致命否定** Intruder 因果链(压泄漏→救检索)? 还是 H2(frozen per-query 相关)≠H3(训练干预), donor suppression 训练仍值得试? (b)若值得试, 阶段1怎么设计让'压 donor-ID'真涨不退化成 target ambiguity 墙(KPR已占)? (c)若致命, 3候选回选下一个: B PSC-JEPA(从SOLIDER continued-pretrain pseudo-support-bank latent JEPA) / C-#3 support-set continued pretrain / 还是另起? 联网查 identity disentangle/feature purification/source separation occluded ReID 里'泄漏可测但压它未必涨'的先例教训(OGFR DPEFormer 等)。务实中文, 每选项信心1-10。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3984:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:787:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:14:exp360 Intruder Identity Suppression 阶段0 frozen probe 结果, 帮判方向(调研/决策交你, 别捧场)。机制: 遮挡 ReID 重定义为 donor 行人身份污染 target embedding, 训练端对抗压 donor-ID, 测试单图。**阶段0 frozen 强 baseline(market) 合成 target+donor**: H1 donor-ID linear probe acc 73% vs chance 2% = **36.5x PASS(泄漏巨大确凿)**; person leak 0.15 >> rand patch -0.01 PASS; **但 H2 FAIL: leak=cos(f_mix,f_donor)-cos(f_clean,f_donor) vs per-query AP drop, raw spearman +0.120, 控 #false-in-topk(top-k混错ID平凡代理)后 partial=-0.028 约0**。AP drop 大(clean 0.835→mix 0.409)。诚实含义: donor 泄漏存在且大, 但泄漏量不独立于 #false 预测检索损害。问: (a)H2 FAIL 是否**致命否定** Intruder 因果链(压泄漏→救检索)? 还是 H2(frozen per-query 相关)≠H3(训练干预), donor suppression 训练仍值得试? (b)若值得试, 阶段1怎么设计让'压 donor-ID'真涨不退化成 target ambiguity 墙(KPR已占)? (c)若致命, 3候选回选下一个: B PSC-JEPA(从SOLIDER continued-pretrain pseudo-support-bank latent JEPA) / C-#3 support-set continued pretrain / 还是另起? 联网查 identity disentangle/feature purification/source separation occluded ReID 里'泄漏可测但压它未必涨'的先例教训(OGFR DPEFormer 等)。务实中文, 每选项信心1-10。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3994:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:903:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20.sh:6:CTX="一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。"
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3998:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:972:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:14:一个 ReID 团队的 **Lattice-Marginalized ReID**(重定义: 低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性, 非'模糊缺细节')零训练 kill-switch = GO。证据: frozen 模型, K=9 phase/bbox/kernel variants 的 ensemble 在 h=16 LR query 上 +4.23 mAP, **比同 K 的普通随机 TTA 多 +3.04**(lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名: lat-MaxSim 46.9>tta 43.8>single 42.6), 74.9% LR query 跨 lattice 变体翻转 rank-1 身份(h升→31%→10%), 过 vs-TTA + vs-#false 双控。**诚实: phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器与 LR-severity 共线(correlational 弱), GO 靠 interventional ensemble 结果(直接测量)。**
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4004:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1024:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4651:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:9441:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/video_feasibility.md:275:一个 ReID 团队连续 4 个 frozen-image 方向被零训练 kill-switch 干净否掉(B 航拍不确定性包含=前提错 / GOPL SMPL正样本可靠性=occlusion-count廉价代理 / Gallery Hubness=诊断真但remedy被k-reciprocal完全占 / OSAC谱过坍缩=前提倒置训练反而升rank)。**frozen-image-retrieval 的隐藏变量都被成熟 test-time 工具(k-reciprocal/camera-aware re-ranking)碾压或证伪, 这条路穷尽。** 唯一真发现=gallery 负向 in-degree hubness(M(q) 解释 AP 误差 rho+0.60, analysis 级非方法)。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4066:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1099:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:5168:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_1.txt:10:廉价 kill-switch：零训练先做三件事。下载 VeRi-776 或 VERI-Wild annotations，用 frozen Swin/CLIP/DINO/已有 ReID checkpoint 跑 seen/unseen type split；统计 top-k false positives 中同 model/color/type 的比例；再做一个 test-time 语义原型惩罚或 subtraction。如果 unseen mAP 没有明显改善，或错误不集中在同车型同色假阳性，直接杀。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4070:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1127:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:7569:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:1886:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:14:一个 ReID 团队的 **Lattice-Marginalized ReID**(重定义: 低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性, 非'模糊缺细节')零训练 kill-switch = GO。证据: frozen 模型, K=9 phase/bbox/kernel variants 的 ensemble 在 h=16 LR query 上 +4.23 mAP, **比同 K 的普通随机 TTA 多 +3.04**(lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名: lat-MaxSim 46.9>tta 43.8>single 42.6), 74.9% LR query 跨 lattice 变体翻转 rank-1 身份(h升→31%→10%), 过 vs-TTA + vs-#false 双控。**诚实: phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器与 LR-severity 共线(correlational 弱), GO 靠 interventional ensemble 结果(直接测量)。**
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4071:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1132:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:8085:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:14:一个 ReID 团队的 **Lattice-Marginalized ReID**(重定义: 低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性, 非'模糊缺细节')零训练 kill-switch = GO。证据: frozen 模型, K=9 phase/bbox/kernel variants 的 ensemble 在 h=16 LR query 上 +4.23 mAP, **比同 K 的普通随机 TTA 多 +3.04**(lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名: lat-MaxSim 46.9>tta 43.8>single 42.6), 74.9% LR query 跨 lattice 变体翻转 rank-1 身份(h升→31%→10%), 过 vs-TTA + vs-#false 双控。**诚实: phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器与 LR-severity 共线(correlational 弱), GO 靠 interventional ensemble 结果(直接测量)。**
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4207:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1609:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3622:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5546:reassess/r_3.md:5139:本地 exp109 的原始记录比当前叙述更细：oracle support bank 上界是强阳性，但它用 GT same-ID prototype，是“知道目标身份以后怎么补”的上界；这正是 donor-source-separation 必须绕开的墙。真正的 kill-switch 不能只测“泄漏能不能被检测”，必须在 frozen 特征上直接测“无 GT 身份、只按遮挡源压制后，排序是否上升”。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21695:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3871:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:20:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4796:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21714:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3890:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:8:- **不是小调参**：LM-ReID 是新机制（lattice-marginalized embedding），重定义低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性；有零训练 kill-switch GO（独立轴、双 trivial 控制 vs-TTA/vs-#false 都过、GO 靠 interventional 直接测量）做前置，codex 判 CCF-B 7/10。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5079:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21997:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4493:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1920:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:132:2. **vs-#false**：控制“多试几次总会撞上更好结果”的假象，可以用 shuffled lattice labels、非 lattice photometric variants、或 same-K random harmless variants。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5125:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22043:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4539:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2578:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:14:Review the files experiments/cargo_cvpb/maxsim_probe.py and experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py (CARGO aerial-ground person ReID, empirical CVPB method). afd_train.py 含 --ovp 的 OVPMemory: 每pid维护aerial/ground两个EMA原型(buffer[num_pid,2,2048] momentum0.2), InfoNCE把样本拉到自己pid的opposite-view原型(τ0.05 λ0.5), total=CE+triplet+λ·OVP。逐行查: bug/runtime/shape/device/AMP数值安全; EMA更新+InfoNCE+cold-start mask正确性; train/test对称; --ovp off是否精确复现baseline。用web search查novelty撞车: opposite-view/cross-view EMA prototype + InfoNCE 在 aerial-ground 或 person ReID 的先例(查 PDPA 2025 CARGO / CMPC / MBCE VI-ReID)。输出 Verdict(approve/needs-attention)+ findings(severity Critical/High/Medium/Low)。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5127:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22045:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4541:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2642:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3533:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:14:Review the files experiments/cargo_cvpb/maxsim_probe.py and experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py (CARGO aerial-ground person ReID, empirical CVPB method). afd_train.py 含 --ovp 的 OVPMemory: 每pid维护aerial/ground两个EMA原型(buffer[num_pid,2,2048] momentum0.2), InfoNCE把样本拉到自己pid的opposite-view原型(τ0.05 λ0.5), total=CE+triplet+λ·OVP。逐行查: bug/runtime/shape/device/AMP数值安全; EMA更新+InfoNCE+cold-start mask正确性; train/test对称; --ovp off是否精确复现baseline。用web search查novelty撞车: opposite-view/cross-view EMA prototype + InfoNCE 在 aerial-ground 或 person ReID 的先例(查 PDPA 2025 CARGO / CMPC / MBCE VI-ReID)。输出 Verdict(approve/needs-attention)+ findings(severity Critical/High/Medium/Low)。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5295:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_4.txt:7:- 廉价 kill-switch：零训练可做。拿开源 VI checkpoint 或先训一个最小 baseline，在 SYSU/RegDB test split 中随机隐藏 20/50/80% 身份的 gallery 正样本，把对应 query 标成 absent。看 top-1 distance/margin 是否能区分 present vs absent；如果 AUROC 已经很高、FAR 很低，杀掉。若 re-ranking 提升 closed-set 却显著放大 absent false accept，这就是强证据。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5297:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_5.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5321:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_1.md:97:廉价 kill-switch：零训练先做三件事。下载 VeRi-776 或 VERI-Wild annotations，用 frozen Swin/CLIP/DINO/已有 ReID checkpoint 跑 seen/unseen type split；统计 top-k false positives 中同 model/color/type 的比例；再做一个 test-time 语义原型惩罚或 subtraction。如果 unseen mAP 没有明显改善，或错误不集中在同车型同色假阳性，直接杀。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5325:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_9.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5358:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_10.md:88:- 零训练 kill-switch：用 frozen SOLIDER/exp030a 特征，按 query-camera 到 gallery-camera 的 train support 分桶，算 pair-conditioned mAP/R1；控制 positive 数量、gallery size、occlusion 后，tail-pair 比 head-pair 仍低 5-8 mAP 才继续。再跑一次 2025 camera-specific feature normalization 后 gap 仍在，才说明不是普通 camera bias。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.10195))
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5359:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_10.md:96:- 零训练 kill-switch：用 Market/MSMT/CARGO 构造 Zipf arrival stream，frozen 特征跑 nearest-centroid/global-threshold/DBSCAN/k-reciprocal baseline。看 false-merge 是否随 head support count 单调上升；再测一个 support-calibrated threshold 是否在相同 known-ID recall 下显著降 tail false merge。若全局阈值已解决，直接杀。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5360:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_10.md:107:- 零训练 kill-switch：用 frozen SOLIDER/exp030a 特征，按 query-camera 到 gallery-camera 的 train support 分桶，算 pair-conditioned mAP/R1；控制 positive 数量、gallery size、occlusion 后，tail-pair 比 head-pair 仍低 5-8 mAP 才继续。再跑一次 2025 camera-specific feature normalization 后 gap 仍在，才说明不是普通 camera bias。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.10195))

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5371:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_4.md:86:- 廉价 kill-switch：零训练可做。拿开源 VI checkpoint 或先训一个最小 baseline，在 SYSU/RegDB test split 中随机隐藏 20/50/80% 身份的 gallery 正样本，把对应 query 标成 absent。看 top-1 distance/margin 是否能区分 present vs absent；如果 AUROC 已经很高、FAR 很低，杀掉。若 re-ranking 提升 closed-set 却显著放大 absent false accept，这就是强证据。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5560:ReID 范式转向终局决策(调研交给你, 不判死, 帮选+审视可行性)。3 路 gap analysis 收敛: 遮挡 ReID 根问题=single-image support incomplete(项目 exp109 oracle 证 +8.5 mAP headroom)。两个最强候选二选一去 build: **#1 T-SCD(Temporal Support-Complete Distillation, 7.5/10)**: 训练用 occluded_posetrack tracklet(同 ID 多帧)构 support-complete teacher 蒸馏进单图 student, 测试单图。**#2 Intruder Identity Suppression(6.8/10)**: 遮挡重定义为另一行人身份泄漏进 target embedding, 训练合成 target+donor 显式压 donor-ID(GRL/adversarial)+clean-occluded consistency。**关键审视**: 项目 memory 记 exp109 的 +8.5 oracle headroom 是'identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙'(测试时不知 ID 没法 complete support; 三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/95.8%可见; 当年结论'别在 ReID 内部找机制')。问: (a)T-SCD 把 identity-conditioned support 放训练端(tracklet privileged info)蒸馏进单图 student, 是真绕过 exp109 测试端墙, 还是又撞同一堵墙(privileged distillation gap/student 学不会)? 诚实判断别捧场。(b)T-SCD vs Intruder 哪个更值得 build(野心×可行×novelty×B类×绕开项目死区)? (c)选定方向的最终 pipeline + 头号风险 + 头号 kill-switch(第一周能看的)。联网查 privileged/temporal distillation to single-image occluded ReID + identity source separation ReID 的 2024-26 novelty 先例。务实中文, 信心 1-10。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:6311:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:5763:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4448:./reassess/r_3.md:5139:本地 exp109 的原始记录比当前叙述更细：oracle support bank 上界是强阳性，但它用 GT same-ID prototype，是“知道目标身份以后怎么补”的上界；这正是 donor-source-separation 必须绕开的墙。真正的 kill-switch 不能只测“泄漏能不能被检测”，必须在 frozen 特征上直接测“无 GT 身份、只按遮挡源压制后，排序是否上升”。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:6326:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:6955:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14:ReID 范式转向终局决策(调研交给你, 不判死, 帮选+审视可行性)。3 路 gap analysis 收敛: 遮挡 ReID 根问题=single-image support incomplete(项目 exp109 oracle 证 +8.5 mAP headroom)。两个最强候选二选一去 build: **#1 T-SCD(Temporal Support-Complete Distillation, 7.5/10)**: 训练用 occluded_posetrack tracklet(同 ID 多帧)构 support-complete teacher 蒸馏进单图 student, 测试单图。**#2 Intruder Identity Suppression(6.8/10)**: 遮挡重定义为另一行人身份泄漏进 target embedding, 训练合成 target+donor 显式压 donor-ID(GRL/adversarial)+clean-occluded consistency。**关键审视**: 项目 memory 记 exp109 的 +8.5 oracle headroom 是'identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙'(测试时不知 ID 没法 complete support; 三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/95.8%可见; 当年结论'别在 ReID 内部找机制')。问: (a)T-SCD 把 identity-conditioned support 放训练端(tracklet privileged info)蒸馏进单图 student, 是真绕过 exp109 测试端墙, 还是又撞同一堵墙(privileged distillation gap/student 学不会)? 诚实判断别捧场。(b)T-SCD vs Intruder 哪个更值得 build(野心×可行×novelty×B类×绕开项目死区)? (c)选定方向的最终 pipeline + 头号风险 + 头号 kill-switch(第一周能看的)。联网查 privileged/temporal distillation to single-image occluded ReID + identity source separation ReID 的 2024-26 novelty 先例。务实中文, 信心 1-10。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:6356:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:15653:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:6992:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:2929:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4448:./reassess/r_3.md:5139:本地 exp109 的原始记录比当前叙述更细：oracle support bank 上界是强阳性，但它用 GT same-ID prototype，是“知道目标身份以后怎么补”的上界；这正是 donor-source-separation 必须绕开的墙。真正的 kill-switch 不能只测“泄漏能不能被检测”，必须在 frozen 特征上直接测“无 GT 身份、只按遮挡源压制后，排序是否上升”。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:6853:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:5763:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4448:./reassess/r_3.md:5139:本地 exp109 的原始记录比当前叙述更细：oracle support bank 上界是强阳性，但它用 GT same-ID prototype，是“知道目标身份以后怎么补”的上界；这正是 donor-source-separation 必须绕开的墙。真正的 kill-switch 不能只测“泄漏能不能被检测”，必须在 frozen 特征上直接测“无 GT 身份、只按遮挡源压制后，排序是否上升”。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9184:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:688:**两数据集一致: 控住 `#false-in-topk` 后 M(q) 偏相关塌到 ≈0（甚至略负）, 而 `#false-in-topk` 控住 M 后仍 +0.51/+0.18。** 即 M(q) 完全可被"top-k 里错的多少个"这个 trivial 计数取代, 反之不行。原 §3/§4 的 D3"partial+0.60"只控了较弱的 norm/margin/camera/#pos, **从未控 `#false-in-topk`**——这是 D3 漏掉的最致命代理。→ **"gallery 负向 in-degree / many-to-one 拓扑"作为 AP-err 解释变量, 相对 trivial 代理无增量价值。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:708:连续 rho 只 ~+0.25（被大量 M=0 query 稀释, 5 箱里 3 箱 M≈0）, 但**分箱趋势干净**: 高 M(q) query 正是 k-reciprocal 修复增益最大的（OD 4.3×, Market 4.5×, 两集一致）。→ **P4 reframe 在分箱意义上成立**: "M(q) 标记了现成 re-rank 工具受益最大的 query"。这是验证后唯一仍站得住、可写的正向叙事（但注意 §P0c: M 此处可能也只是 `#false-in-topk` 的代理, reframe 同样可用 #false 复述, 严谨写作需在 P4 也加 `#false` 对照)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9186:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:711:~~M(q) 干净解释 AP 误差(rho+0.60, 控代理后仍在)~~ → **修订**: (1) rho+0.60/+0.65 含 circular self-loop, 去 circular（LOO/held-out）后降到 +0.33（OD）/+0.25（Market）; (2) **决定性**: 控 trivial 代理 `#false-in-topk` 后 M(q) 偏相关 ≈0（两集一致 −0.06/−0.05）, 即"gallery 负向 in-degree / 拓扑"框架相对"top-k 里错几个"无增量解释力——原 D3 漏控了这个最致命代理; (3) P3 机制只半支持（去背景 −47%, 但去人 −87% 反更大, 非纯场景因子）; (4) **唯一仍正向**: P4 高 M(q) query 正是 k-reciprocal 修复最多的（分箱 4.3×/4.5×, 两集一致）。→ **作为"诊断变量"的 headline 站不住**（被 trivial 代理吃掉）; 若要保留, 只能定位成"M(q)/负向 in-degree 标记 re-rank 高收益 query"的弱 reframe, 且必须诚实写明它相对 `#false-in-topk` 无增量。**当前形态不足以撑 analysis short 的核心 claim。**

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9237:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1612:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_28.md:6933:机制也比较自然。为了不逐对比对，就仍然保留 ReID 的特征提取加相似度检索范式。为了用 LVLM 的语义理解能力，就用指令让 Qwen2-VL 针对行人图像生成一个 `<REID>` 语义 token，要求关注年龄、性别、衣着、生物特征。为了让这个 token 不只是孤立文本输出，设计 SGI，把语义 token 和视觉 tokens 拼起来经过 4 层 Transformer 交互，最后用强化后的语义 token 作为身份表示。为了处理相机变化，又加 camera semantic supplementation，最好的是把相机 embedding 加到视觉 patch embedding 上。训练用 ID loss 和 triplet loss，LLM 冻结但允许梯度穿过它更新视觉模型和 SGI。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9238:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1613:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_28.md:6936:关键消融是三组。第一，只用 LVLM 的 visual model 做 baseline 效果低，说明单纯视觉 tokens 不够。第二，把 LVLM 生成的 semantic token 换成随机 learnable token 后明显掉点，说明 `<REID>` token 的语义来源有用，不只是多了一个 class token。第三，去掉 SGI 后效果也掉，说明 token 需要和视觉 tokens 交互，而不是直接拿生成 token 检索。CSS 的消融显示把相机语义放到输入 patch embedding 比放到 `<REID>` token 后面更好，说明相机偏移要早处理。检索可视化显示 baseline 容易被颜色、衣服、姿态误导，而语义 token 引导后能抓住图案、配饰和遮挡下的细节。推理时间从 784ms 到 906ms 处理 64 张图，用来缓解“LVLM 太慢”的质疑。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9268:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:2530:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_14.md:6593:3. 机制怎么长出来：SPG 先产生局部语义 patch，AHSTG 用区分性和身份相关性打分，选择不同形状和尺度的异质 token；如果 token 间空间距离大，就认为中间可能缺失，插入 recovery token，并让近邻 token 权重大、远邻权重小。前半段逻辑很顺，DFR 的距离假设更像一个合理启发。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9269:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:2531:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_14.md:6600:3. 机制怎么长出来：FHFM 根据 class token 注意力和 patch 范数给 patch 排重要性，分四层融合；FSM 用 saliency map 分前景和背景；LFEM 加四个局部 token，并用 mask 限制只在同一人体区域内交互。逻辑能对上观察，但三模块有些“全都要”，绑定程度中等。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9270:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:2537:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_14.md:6640:3. 机制怎么长出来：SPG 先产生局部语义 patch，AHSTG 用区分性和身份相关性打分，选择不同形状和尺度的异质 token；如果 token 间空间距离大，就认为中间可能缺失，插入 recovery token，并让近邻 token 权重大、远邻权重小。前半段逻辑很顺，DFR 的距离假设更像一个合理启发。

First, the patch tokens in Branch 1 are
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9273:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3139:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:1690:./reviews/deep_15.md:3588:features to construct patch、global 拉到同一个语义方向。聚类阶段也用语义一致的细粒度特征和 global 特征融合成距离矩阵。CCF 模块在 memory bank 初始化前，用 global cluster centroid 过滤偏离身份中心的局部特征。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9274:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3157:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3020:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1528:3. 机制怎么长出来：机制基本是顺着这个重定义长出来的。主体 token S* 来自全局图像特征，表示“这是谁”；属性 token A* 由 learnable queries 从 patch 中提取可见身份属性；上下文 token O* 提取遮挡物特征。三者组成 “A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*]” 这样的细粒度 prompt，再用文本作为 query 对视觉 patch 做 cross-attention，引导图像特征看可见人体区域、压掉遮挡物。动态融合用预测不确定性给 visual、text、cross-attention feature 分配权重，是对可靠性问题的补强。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9275:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3159:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3042:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1611:3. 机制怎么长出来：ABF 不直接切最后层特征，而是在 ViT 中后层复制 CLS 作为局部 token，并用 attention bias 限制每个局部 token 只关注对应 patch 组，同时保留全局路径。FEL 用共享可学习 token 和多模态解码器从文本中聚合细粒度语义。TES 用局部视觉表示监督 FEL，把 CLIP 空间里的余弦关系和欧氏距离关系转移给细粒度文本表示。MoD 和零初始化用于避免随机局部 token 一开始学噪声。这个机制和重定义绑定非常紧。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9276:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3169:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3095:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1823:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果同一身份的文本 token 应该稳定对齐多个视角图像，就自然推出 `TCL`，约束同一身份多视角图像与文本的相似度方差；如果文本 token 已经学到稳定身份语义，就用 `SFM` 通过文本引导的空间注意力和通道重权重过滤图像 patch。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9277:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3254:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:4522:../litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:3261:区别：最像 MCCAN 和 DHGN 的多粒度对齐，但它们仍在二维 patch 或视频部位上对齐；我们用 SMPL 把 SOLIDER token 投到规范人体表面，只比较共同可见且几何可信的身体表面区域。也不同于换衣 ReID 里的 3D shape，它不是拿 3D 当身份线索，而是拿 3D 当跨视角坐标系。  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9278:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3255:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:4523:../litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:3262:廉价首验：冻结 SOLIDER，在一小批航拍地面配对上估计 SMPL 或关键点，把 patch 特征池化到 8 到 16 个身体表面区域，比较原始全局特征和表面对齐特征的正负样本间隔、rank1 和 mAP。若航拍 query 没有明显改善，或者改善被普通水平分块吃掉，就停。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9283:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3511:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:7365:./validate/v_3.md:2751:../codex_review_ovli.txt:3956:experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:44:- **exp324d 第2次（本次）已启动**（2026-06-16，lab-3090-d）：`scripts/exp324d_lora.py` 写好——LoRA(q/v rank8 alpha16) 解冻 DINOv2-base + **可微姿态部位池化**(预算每图 row-stochastic 池化矩阵 pool_w，`bmm(pool_w,patch)` 梯度回流 LoRA) + exp324b 同款头/损失/PK64/part-MaxSim eval。**唯一变量=LoRA 解冻 DINO**。双审查 approve（Claude 含 200-trial 池化等价 1.79e-7；Codex 141k tok 确认梯度到 LoRA/full-batch triplet/use_reentrant=False/eval 对称，组合 plausibly new 未找直接先例）。Dry-run：LoRA 294,912+head 413,184 训练，loss↓ acc 0.016→0.766，显存 13.7G/24G，~1.4s/step。全量 35ep 后台跑（micro_bs64 no-ckpt）。**待结果：part-MaxSim 重遮挡 mAP 能否破 exp324b 的 8.65 / 全部破 14.61 往 competitive 走。**【结果待填】
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9284:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3518:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:7390:./validate/v_3.md:2776:../codex_review_ovli.txt:3981:experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:405:按用户睡前"不停+cheap kill-switch first"，自主把 TBPS 唯一幸存候选 PartNC 推到"数据一到就能判生死"：agent 读懂 RDE 接口(checkpoint 加载 / image 192-patch+text 77-token 特征 / CCD 的 min-max+2-GMM+低均值簇后验)，写 `scripts/partnc_killswitch.py`(本地+lab-3090-d，md5 一致)：(a) spaCy+lexicon 切 caption head/torso/legs + 部位级噪声注入(参数化, 有 regex fallback)；(b) RDE token 特征算 noun-phrase×patch per-part MaxSim cleanliness(复刻 eval_fliptest_maxsim einsum.max)；(c) AUROC(part-level) vs AUROC(实例级CCD)；(d) verdict。逻辑全验证通过(切分/注入/加载/形状/MaxSim/GMM/AUROC 方向性单测)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9285:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3520:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:7393:./validate/v_3.md:2779:../codex_review_ovli.txt:3984:experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:490:- **加 part-MaxSim kill-switch(防 false-KILL)**: pooled 判据可能误杀——cls 是训练检索特征, patch-pool 天生弱于它。加 token 级 part-MaxSim 版本(128 patch→6 水平 part-band, 全局 burst 权重降权 band 内 bursty patch, part-MaxSim 检索 burst vs uniform)。pretrained smoke 全跑通: pooled burst−uniform=-0.01, part-MaxSim burst−uniform=-0.03(均 KILL, 未训练应如此=harness 校准正确)。e120 自动触发用更新脚本, 一次出 pooled+part-MaxSim 双判据 + 训练模型诊断。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9306:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5830:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9328:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7885:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1887:./reviews/deep_25.md:14097:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“遮挡区域检测不准”，而是拆成“pose misalignment under extreme occlusion”和“identity confusion caused by non-target pedestrian occlusion”。关键词是 pose-patch mapping、texture-aware decoder、non-target pedestrian occlusion、structure and detail dual constraints。这个拆解让方法天然有两个核心动作：结构上精确映射，细节上用纹理区分目标。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9329:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7886:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1888:./reviews/deep_25.md:14099:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MFE 先在 ViT patch 上做 intra-patch 和 inter-patch 编码，补足 patch 内外层级信息。PPM 不做 pose-to-global，而是把 pose 和 patch 当成两种模态，用 Mahalanobis distance 加 cosine similarity 建 pose-patch 相似矩阵，只保留高置信关键点对应的 patch，从而降低局部 pose 错误的全局污染。TAD 再用 context extraction layer 和 texture extraction layer，以 PPM 过滤后的 pose 特征为约束，通过 cross-attention 强化可区分纹理。pose loss 还约束人体和非人体映射特征不要太相似。机制和两个失败场景绑定得比较紧。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9335:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7932:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3020:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1528:3. 机制怎么长出来：机制基本是顺着这个重定义长出来的。主体 token S* 来自全局图像特征，表示“这是谁”；属性 token A* 由 learnable queries 从 patch 中提取可见身份属性；上下文 token O* 提取遮挡物特征。三者组成 “A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*]” 这样的细粒度 prompt，再用文本作为 query 对视觉 patch 做 cross-attention，引导图像特征看可见人体区域、压掉遮挡物。动态融合用预测不确定性给 visual、text、cross-attention feature 分配权重，是对可靠性问题的补强。

A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9416:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10630:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9443:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:11011:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2973:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1303:2. 重定义动作：大家以为主要矛盾是伪标签净化或 patch 设计；作者改成“先做语义感知的身份与摄像头解耦，再在身份相关特征上生成语义 patch”。关键词是 `semantic-aware disentanglement`、`identity-related features`、`camera-related features`、`diffusion over spatial transformer parameters`。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9444:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:11021:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3020:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1528:3. 机制怎么长出来：机制基本是顺着这个重定义长出来的。主体 token S* 来自全局图像特征，表示“这是谁”；属性 token A* 由 learnable queries 从 patch 中提取可见身份属性；上下文 token O* 提取遮挡物特征。三者组成 “A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*]” 这样的细粒度 prompt，再用文本作为 query 对视觉 patch 做 cross-attention，引导图像特征看可见人体区域、压掉遮挡物。动态融合用预测不确定性给 visual、text、cross-attention feature 分配权重，是对可靠性问题的补强。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9445:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:11030:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3151:../litreview/reviews/lit_17.md:3140:cheap kill-switch：先在少量 AG-ReID/CARGO 样本上跑现有 SMPL/pose 管线，冻结 SOLIDER，只做 mesh surface pooling。若 SMPL 投影在航拍上失败率高，或同一表面区域的跨视角相似度不优于普通 patch/pose part，直接止损。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9462:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:14407:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3158:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4718:reassess/r_2.md:2566:pivot/p_2.md:3657:./validate/v_3.md:15504:../litreview2/validate/v_3.md:8060:./validate/v_2.md:12736:validate/v_3.md:2779:../codex_review_ovli.txt:3984:experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:490:- **加 part-MaxSim kill-switch(防 false-KILL)**: pooled 判据可能误杀——cls 是训练检索特征, patch-pool 天生弱于它。加 token 级 part-MaxSim 版本(128 patch→6 水平 part-band, 全局 burst 权重降权 band 内 bursty patch, part-MaxSim 检索 burst vs uniform)。pretrained smoke 全跑通: pooled burst−uniform=-0.01, part-MaxSim burst−uniform=-0.03(均 KILL, 未训练应如此=harness 校准正确)。e120 自动触发用更新脚本, 一次出 pooled+part-MaxSim 双判据 + 训练模型诊断。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9463:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:14486:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3379:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4940:reassess/r_2.md:2855:pivot/p_2.md:4678:./pivot/p_1.md:28:我会先核对近年航拍-地面 ReID、跨分辨率 ReID、token/patch 聚合与池化相关方法，重点看是否已经把“航拍平滑低细节”当作核心问题来建模。随后按你的四个约束筛候选，并给每个候选配一个零训练 kill-switch。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9464:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:14578:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5462:reassess/r_3.md:4768:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:471:- **为何非已关方向**: 与 visibility 加权**正交**(visibility 问"是否被遮挡"二值; burstiness 问"这个可见特征是否被过度计数"集内冗余统计)。一个 part 可完全可见且高 visibility 却 bursty(大块平躯干)——现有方法升权它, burstiness 说降权。非 completion(不重建)、非 scorer 微变体(改特征集聚合)、非 uncertainty(无 per-feature 置信)。**Novelty 已核: 无 occluded-ReID 做 burst-aware/democratic over part/patch 特征**(最近 cousin = Self-similarity guided probabilistic matching ESWA'23 是去噪/校验, 相反符号)。详见 memory [[burstiness-democratic-aggregation-bet]]。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9475:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:15063:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9497:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:16072:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1613:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_28.md:6936:关键消融是三组。第一，只用 LVLM 的 visual model 做 baseline 效果低，说明单纯视觉 tokens 不够。第二，把 LVLM 生成的 semantic token 换成随机 learnable token 后明显掉点，说明 `<REID>` token 的语义来源有用，不只是多了一个 class token。第三，去掉 SGI 后效果也掉，说明 token 需要和视觉 tokens 交互，而不是直接拿生成 token 检索。CSS 的消融显示把相机语义放到输入 patch embedding 比放到 `<REID>` token 后面更好，说明相机偏移要早处理。检索可视化显示 baseline 容易被颜色、衣服、姿态误导，而语义 token 引导后能抓住图案、配饰和遮挡下的细节。推理时间从 784ms 到 906ms 处理 64 张图，用来缓解“LVLM 太慢”的质疑。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9505:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17524:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1920:reassess/r_3.md:4493:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9509:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17582:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8005:./reassess/r_3.md:4493:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9510:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17653:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9515:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17700:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9562:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17929:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4400:./reassess/r_3.md:4482:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:21:"mechanism": "TTPM is a ViT + HRNet pipeline with three parts and no occlusion-sample augmentation. A Multi-patch Feature Encoder encodes intra-patch and inter-patch features (re-grouping patches at 2x scale with the cls token). Pose-Patch Mapping (PPM) builds a fine-grained, per-patch positional correspondence between M pose keypoints and N patches via a learned similarity S = gamma*D_M - eta*S_M that combines an affine-extended Mahalanobis distance and affine-extended cosine similarity, gates out low-confidence keypoints by a heatmap-confidence threshold, and selects the argmax-similarity patch per keypoint, thereby down-weighting occluded patches without coarse global pose mapping. A Texture-Aware Decoder (context-extraction MHSA layers + texture-extraction MHCA layers using pose-filtered features as queries) leverages texture distinctiveness to separate the target from non-target pedestrian occluders. An auxiliary pose loss penalizes high cosine similarity between human-part and non-human (background) features.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9563:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17930:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4401:./reassess/r_3.md:4483:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:22:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas for occluded ReID. (1) The pose loss L_p that explicitly minimizes cosine similarity between body-part features and non-human/background features — a cheap regularizer to suppress occluder/background leakage into the identity embedding, applicable to any pose- or part-based occluded model. (2) The texture-distinctiveness decoder channel aimed specifically at non-target PEDESTRIAN occlusion: when the occluder is itself a person, pose/structure cues fail (same skeleton topology), so using texture appearance distinctiveness (via pose-filtered queries cross-attending to contextual features) to push apart target vs distractor-person is a concrete mechanism for the under-addressed person-on-person occlusion case. Also transferable: replacing coarse pose-to-global mapping with a per-keypoint-to-patch confidence-gated argmax correspondence (Mahalanobis+cosine affine similarity) to localize visible regions.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9564:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17931:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9565:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17932:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4403:./reassess/r_3.md:4491:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:86:"transfer_to_occluded": "Apply the text-level orthogonal-projection disentanglement to occlusion: learn a dual prompt for the OCCLUDER/distractor (e.g. \"a photo of the [X]...[X] occluder\") alongside the ID prompt, then orthogonalize the occluder text feature out of the ID text feature (F_ort = F_id - proj of F_occ onto F_id) and use the purged ID text feature to guide the visual encoder via the non-local SIM. Because the non-local operation aggregates from spatially distant but semantically relevant regions, it is well suited to occluded ReID where visible body parts are scattered far from the occluded/corrupted region — letting the model pull ID evidence from non-adjacent visible patches rather than local self-attention that gets dominated by the occluder. The orthogonalization gives a clean way to subtract a known nuisance direction (occluder appearance) without an auxiliary parser.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9566:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17933:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4405:./reassess/r_3.md:4493:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9580:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17999:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4650:./reassess/r_3.md:7994:./reassess/r_3.md:4482:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:21:"mechanism": "TTPM is a ViT + HRNet pipeline with three parts and no occlusion-sample augmentation. A Multi-patch Feature Encoder encodes intra-patch and inter-patch features (re-grouping patches at 2x scale with the cls token). Pose-Patch Mapping (PPM) builds a fine-grained, per-patch positional correspondence between M pose keypoints and N patches via a learned similarity S = gamma*D_M - eta*S_M that combines an affine-extended Mahalanobis distance and affine-extended cosine similarity, gates out low-confidence keypoints by a heatmap-confidence threshold, and selects the argmax-similarity patch per keypoint, thereby down-weighting occluded patches without coarse global pose mapping. A Texture-Aware Decoder (context-extraction MHSA layers + texture-extraction MHCA layers using pose-filtered features as queries) leverages texture distinctiveness to separate the target from non-target pedestrian occluders. An auxiliary pose loss penalizes high cosine similarity between human-part and non-human (background) features.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9581:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:18000:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4651:./reassess/r_3.md:7995:./reassess/r_3.md:4483:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:22:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas for occluded ReID. (1) The pose loss L_p that explicitly minimizes cosine similarity between body-part features and non-human/background features — a cheap regularizer to suppress occluder/background leakage into the identity embedding, applicable to any pose- or part-based occluded model. (2) The texture-distinctiveness decoder channel aimed specifically at non-target PEDESTRIAN occlusion: when the occluder is itself a person, pose/structure cues fail (same skeleton topology), so using texture appearance distinctiveness (via pose-filtered queries cross-attending to contextual features) to push apart target vs distractor-person is a concrete mechanism for the under-addressed person-on-person occlusion case. Also transferable: replacing coarse pose-to-global mapping with a per-keypoint-to-patch confidence-gated argmax correspondence (Mahalanobis+cosine affine similarity) to localize visible regions.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9582:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:18001:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4652:./reassess/r_3.md:7999:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9583:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:18002:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4653:./reassess/r_3.md:8003:./reassess/r_3.md:4491:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:86:"transfer_to_occluded": "Apply the text-level orthogonal-projection disentanglement to occlusion: learn a dual prompt for the OCCLUDER/distractor (e.g. \"a photo of the [X]...[X] occluder\") alongside the ID prompt, then orthogonalize the occluder text feature out of the ID text feature (F_ort = F_id - proj of F_occ onto F_id) and use the purged ID text feature to guide the visual encoder via the non-local SIM. Because the non-local operation aggregates from spatially distant but semantically relevant regions, it is well suited to occluded ReID where visible body parts are scattered far from the occluded/corrupted region — letting the model pull ID evidence from non-adjacent visible patches rather than local self-attention that gets dominated by the occluder. The orthogonalization gives a clean way to subtract a known nuisance direction (occluder appearance) without an auxiliary parser.",
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9584:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:18003:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4655:./reassess/r_3.md:8005:./reassess/r_3.md:4493:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9625:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:18199:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5830:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
