A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9684:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:18810:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10630:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9717:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:19337:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:15063:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9727:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:19670:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:15974:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4405:./reassess/r_3.md:4493:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9732:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:20396:| ③ Gallery Hubness remedy | Kill robust，但要分清：单说“被 k-reciprocal 占”略过强，因为训练成 single embedding 理论上还能争部署价值；但 §7.6 新控制更致命，`M(q)` 控 `#false-in-topk` 后偏相关≈0，说明 hubness 诊断本身无增量。k-reciprocal 本来就是 ReID 里标准、无监督、邻域拓扑 re-ranking。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1701.08398?utm_source=openai)) Hubness 及 hub-aware retrieval 也不是新问题。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.10526?utm_source=openai)) | 9/10 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9733:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:20424:| ③ Gallery Hubness remedy | Kill robust，但要分清：单说“被 k-reciprocal 占”略过强，因为训练成 single embedding 理论上还能争部署价值；但 §7.6 新控制更致命，`M(q)` 控 `#false-in-topk` 后偏相关≈0，说明 hubness 诊断本身无增量。k-reciprocal 本来就是 ReID 里标准、无监督、邻域拓扑 re-ranking。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1701.08398?utm_source=openai)) Hubness 及 hub-aware retrieval 也不是新问题。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.10526?utm_source=openai)) | 9/10 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9751:d17 的上限在于：它如果成立，是“局部证据劫持 ranking”的机制问题，确实比普通 occlusion/part module 更像一个可讲的 failure mode。但它的最大风险也很硬：很可能退化成 `#false-in-topk`、ordinary mask-TTA、part/patch pruning、k-reciprocal/re-ranking 已覆盖的东西。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9761:1. `rank-leverage concentration` 在控制 `#false-in-topk`、top-1 margin、first-positive rank、top-k precision 后仍有独立解释力。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9762:2. false positive pair 的 leverage concentration 明显高于 true positive pair，且在相同 rank / similarity 桶内成立。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9766:如果只得到“false top-k 的局部遮挡后 rank 变化更大”，但控 `#false` 后消失，d17 直接死。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_1.txt:10:廉价 kill-switch：零训练先做三件事。下载 VeRi-776 或 VERI-Wild annotations，用 frozen Swin/CLIP/DINO/已有 ReID checkpoint 跑 seen/unseen type split；统计 top-k false positives 中同 model/color/type 的比例；再做一个 test-time 语义原型惩罚或 subtraction。如果 unseen mAP 没有明显改善，或错误不集中在同车型同色假阳性，直接杀。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_20.txt:4:**触发观察/失败**：标准 ReID 默认 query 是单张正确目标，multi-query 默认多张全是同一 ID。真实部署里更常见的是“用户/检索员给一包候选截图”，其中可能混入跟踪漂移、检测错框、相邻行人、错误截图。大家以为“query support 越多越稳”，其实隐藏变量可能是 **query-bag purity**：多给错图会比单图更坏。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_2.txt:21:触发观察：CC-ReID 统一算 mAP/Rank-1，但不是每张换衣 query 都有足够身份信息。正面脸、清晰头部、稳定肢体、鞋包 carry-over、多视角 support 都会极大改变可匹配性。很多失败不是模型不够强，而是单图证据不足。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_2.txt:25:机制草案：`Biometric Evidence Routing`。为 query-gallery 对构建 cue support：face/head visible、limb visible、body contour quality、artifact volatility、same-clothes support、gallery support density。高证据走对应 cue expert；低证据样本输出低置信或请求 set-query/tracklet/人工复核。训练端可用 evidence-conditioned contrastive：只在共同可见且可靠 cue 上拉近，不对低证据样本过度监督。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_2.txt:29:2. 对 PRCC/LTCC/DeepChange query 按 evidence 分桶，看低 evidence 桶是否贡献主要 false top-k。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_10.txt:5:- 重定义：把 long-tail 从 `identity frequency` 改成 `identity-camera-pair edge / camera-transition support`。大家以为长尾是类频次，其实在 ReID 里关键是“某些跨摄像头转换从训练到测试都没被充分覆盖”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_10.txt:6:- 机制草案：构建 camera-pair support graph；batch/loss 按低支持 camera-pair 采样和加权；约束不同 camera-pair support bin 的 positive margin 分布一致。不要讲 camera-bias normalization，要讲“跨摄像头证据覆盖不均”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_10.txt:7:- 零训练 kill-switch：用 frozen SOLIDER/exp030a 特征，按 query-camera 到 gallery-camera 的 train support 分桶，算 pair-conditioned mAP/R1；控制 positive 数量、gallery size、occlusion 后，tail-pair 比 head-pair 仍低 5-8 mAP 才继续。再跑一次 2025 camera-specific feature normalization 后 gap 仍在，才说明不是普通 camera bias。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.10195))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_10.txt:8:- 撞车核查：APRA 已做 camera performance imbalance 和指标；2025 camera bias/DART³ 已做 test-time camera debias；3C 2024 用 camera information entropy 做无监督聚类置信度。撞车风险中高，但还没看到“camera-pair support long-tail”作为 supervised ReID 主问题。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.01204)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18337)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.09464))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_10.txt:13:- 重定义：long-tail ReID = open-world gallery 中的“尾部身份保全”问题。大家以为 open-set 是阈值问题，其实隐藏变量是 prototype support count：head prototype 越大，越容易吸走未知 tail。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_10.txt:15:- 零训练 kill-switch：用 Market/MSMT/CARGO 构造 Zipf arrival stream，frozen 特征跑 nearest-centroid/global-threshold/DBSCAN/k-reciprocal baseline。看 false-merge 是否随 head support count 单调上升；再测一个 support-calibrated threshold 是否在相同 known-ID recall 下显著降 tail false merge。若全局阈值已解决，直接杀。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_10.txt:16:- 撞车核查：CFReID 2025 是 continual few-shot domain adaptation；LReID backward-compatibility 2024 关注旧 gallery 特征兼容；MICRO-TRACK 2024 做 open-set industrial tracking 和 centroid gallery，但没有把 Zipf singleton false-consolidation 定义成 long-tail 主问题。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.18469)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.10022)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.03879))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_9.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_9.md:50:web search: open set identification face recognition false positive identification rate watchlist threshold
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_9.md:52:web search: "watchlist" "person re-identification" "false alarm"
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_9.md:67:触发观察：大家默认“拒识 = top1 相似度/ margin 设阈值”，但 open-set speaker 的 VoxWatch 已明确指出 watchlist 变大时 out-of-set 最大分数会上升，false alarm 变严重；这在 ReID 里基本没被现代系统性做过。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.00169))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_9.md:107:触发观察：大家默认“拒识 = top1 相似度/ margin 设阈值”，但 open-set speaker 的 VoxWatch 已明确指出 watchlist 变大时 out-of-set 最大分数会上升，false alarm 变严重；这在 ReID 里基本没被现代系统性做过。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.00169))

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_10.md:106:- 机制草案：构建 camera-pair support graph；batch/loss 按低支持 camera-pair 采样和加权；约束不同 camera-pair support bin 的 positive margin 分布一致。不要讲 camera-bias normalization，要讲“跨摄像头证据覆盖不均”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_10.md:107:- 零训练 kill-switch：用 frozen SOLIDER/exp030a 特征，按 query-camera 到 gallery-camera 的 train support 分桶，算 pair-conditioned mAP/R1；控制 positive 数量、gallery size、occlusion 后，tail-pair 比 head-pair 仍低 5-8 mAP 才继续。再跑一次 2025 camera-specific feature normalization 后 gap 仍在，才说明不是普通 camera bias。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.10195))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_10.md:108:- 撞车核查：APRA 已做 camera performance imbalance 和指标；2025 camera bias/DART³ 已做 test-time camera debias；3C 2024 用 camera information entropy 做无监督聚类置信度。撞车风险中高，但还没看到“camera-pair support long-tail”作为 supervised ReID 主问题。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.01204)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18337)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.09464))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_10.md:113:- 重定义：long-tail ReID = open-world gallery 中的“尾部身份保全”问题。大家以为 open-set 是阈值问题，其实隐藏变量是 prototype support count：head prototype 越大，越容易吸走未知 tail。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_10.md:115:- 零训练 kill-switch：用 Market/MSMT/CARGO 构造 Zipf arrival stream，frozen 特征跑 nearest-centroid/global-threshold/DBSCAN/k-reciprocal baseline。看 false-merge 是否随 head support count 单调上升；再测一个 support-calibrated threshold 是否在相同 known-ID recall 下显著降 tail false merge。若全局阈值已解决，直接杀。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_20.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_20.md:979:**触发观察/失败**：标准 ReID 默认 query 是单张正确目标，multi-query 默认多张全是同一 ID。真实部署里更常见的是“用户/检索员给一包候选截图”，其中可能混入跟踪漂移、检测错框、相邻行人、错误截图。大家以为“query support 越多越稳”，其实隐藏变量可能是 **query-bag purity**：多给错图会比单图更坏。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_20.md:1017:**触发观察/失败**：标准 ReID 默认 query 是单张正确目标，multi-query 默认多张全是同一 ID。真实部署里更常见的是“用户/检索员给一包候选截图”，其中可能混入跟踪漂移、检测错框、相邻行人、错误截图。大家以为“query support 越多越稳”，其实隐藏变量可能是 **query-bag purity**：多给错图会比单图更坏。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_5.txt:8:机制草案：先用任意 TIReID baseline 取 top-k；对 top false positive 构造/接收一条 relative correction；训练一个 pairwise relative scorer，输入 `(query, candidate, distractor)`，输出 candidate 是否更符合“相对差异”。不要做 MLLM 交互主方法，也不要做 token prototype；核心是 distractor-conditioned scoring + relative triplet training。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_5.txt:11:1. 用现有 baseline 找 top-1 false cases。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_5.txt:12:2. 用 GT caption 与 false-positive caption 的差异模拟一句用户纠错，例如 “not carrying a bag / pants are lighter / upper clothes are red rather than black”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_1.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_1.md:97:廉价 kill-switch：零训练先做三件事。下载 VeRi-776 或 VERI-Wild annotations，用 frozen Swin/CLIP/DINO/已有 ReID checkpoint 跑 seen/unseen type split；统计 top-k false positives 中同 model/color/type 的比例；再做一个 test-time 语义原型惩罚或 subtraction。如果 unseen mAP 没有明显改善，或错误不集中在同车型同色假阳性，直接杀。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_4.md:83:- 触发观察：标准 VI-ReID 默认 query 一定在 gallery 里；真实夜间红外检索里，大量 IR 行人根本不在白天可见光 watchlist。现有模型和 re-ranking 必然返回一个人，可能制造高置信 false alarm。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_4.md:85:- 机制草案：用 Swin/SOLIDER 做 VI backbone，增加 `existence/energy` 头。训练时做 episodic gallery dropout：对部分训练身份故意移除跨模态正样本，构造 no-match episode；再用 nearest impostor 做 hard negative，学习“有跨模态证据才接受”。评测报 closed-set mAP/R1 + `DIR@FAR`、AUROC、false accept rate。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_4.md:86:- 廉价 kill-switch：零训练可做。拿开源 VI checkpoint 或先训一个最小 baseline，在 SYSU/RegDB test split 中随机隐藏 20/50/80% 身份的 gallery 正样本，把对应 query 标成 absent。看 top-1 distance/margin 是否能区分 present vs absent；如果 AUROC 已经很高、FAR 很低，杀掉。若 re-ranking 提升 closed-set 却显著放大 absent false accept，这就是强证据。

experiments/exp111/design.md:5:`exp110` 证明了训练端的 `support-complete prototype distillation` 能在单 seed 上转正，但增益仍然偏弱。当前实现里 `POSE_SCKD_MIN_COUNT=1`，意味着某个 identity 的某个 keypoint 只要出现过一次 high-visibility 观测，就会被当作 teacher 使用。这种 teacher 过于宽松，容易把偶然噪声、姿态抽取误差、遮挡下的不稳定局部都写入 bank。
experiments/exp111/design.md:7:用户也明确强调了当前阶段应优先探索“真正有效且足够支撑论文的创新点”，而不是提前做多 seed 收尾。因此下一步最合理的单变量推进，不是重复验证，而是把 `support-complete` 主线里的关键机制继续做实。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:12414:### 3. 不能再假设“同 ID 跨图 support 一定比单图更好学”

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:12426:### Gap A: 单图内部能否合成“伪多 support”？

   935	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:14:exp360 Intruder Identity Suppression 阶段0 frozen probe 结果, 帮判方向(调研/决策交你, 别捧场)。机制: 遮挡 ReID 重定义为 donor 行人身份污染 target embedding, 训练端对抗压 donor-ID, 测试单图。**阶段0 frozen 强 baseline(market) 合成 target+donor**: H1 donor-ID linear probe acc 73% vs chance 2% = **36.5x PASS(泄漏巨大确凿)**; person leak 0.15 >> rand patch -0.01 PASS; **但 H2 FAIL: leak=cos(f_mix,f_donor)-cos(f_clean,f_donor) vs per-query AP drop, raw spearman +0.120, 控 #false-in-topk(top-k混错ID平凡代理)后 partial=-0.028 约0**。AP drop 大(clean 0.835→mix 0.409)。诚实含义: donor 泄漏存在且大, 但泄漏量不独立于 #false 预测检索损害。问: (a)H2 FAIL 是否**致命否定** Intruder 因果链(压泄漏→救检索)? 还是 H2(frozen per-query 相关)≠H3(训练干预), donor suppression 训练仍值得试? (b)若值得试, 阶段1怎么设计让'压 donor-ID'真涨不退化成 target ambiguity 墙(KPR已占)? (c)若致命, 3候选回选下一个: B PSC-JEPA(从SOLIDER continued-pretrain pseudo-support-bank latent JEPA) / C-#3 support-set continued pretrain / 还是另起? 联网查 identity disentangle/feature purification/source separation occluded ReID 里'泄漏可测但压它未必涨'的先例教训(OGFR DPEFormer 等)。务实中文, 每选项信心1-10。

   947	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:903:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20.sh:6:CTX="一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。"
   948	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:972:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:14:一个 ReID 团队的 **Lattice-Marginalized ReID**(重定义: 低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性, 非'模糊缺细节')零训练 kill-switch = GO。证据: frozen 模型, K=9 phase/bbox/kernel variants 的 ensemble 在 h=16 LR query 上 +4.23 mAP, **比同 K 的普通随机 TTA 多 +3.04**(lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名: lat-MaxSim 46.9>tta 43.8>single 42.6), 74.9% LR query 跨 lattice 变体翻转 rank-1 身份(h升→31%→10%), 过 vs-TTA + vs-#false 双控。**诚实: phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器与 LR-severity 共线(correlational 弱), GO 靠 interventional ensemble 结果(直接测量)。**

   950	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1023:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4632:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:8892:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:43:We tested the obvious remedies and report them honestly. A zero-training hub penalty `score' = cos − λ·log(1+H_k)` gives only +0.31 (Market) / +1.51 (Occluded-Duke) mAP, and is **dominated** by same-camera down-weighting (+0.67 / +3.13) and k-reciprocal (+1.26 / **+10.98**)—the gap *widens* on the harder set. A training-side anti-hub embedding sits in the same space already covered by re-ranking. The mechanism (scene over-encoding) points to background/region suppression, which is non-generalizable here (a dataset-specific scene) and overlaps prior pose-masked suppression. We therefore present negative in-degree as a **diagnostic**: it tells you *where* strong ReID fails and *why* (gallery topology / non-identity factor), while the *fix* remains the province of established test-time tools.

   960	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1033:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4738:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12950:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:43:We tested the obvious remedies and report them honestly. A zero-training hub penalty `score' = cos − λ·log(1+H_k)` gives only +0.31 (Market) / +1.51 (Occluded-Duke) mAP, and is **dominated** by same-camera down-weighting (+0.67 / +3.13) and k-reciprocal (+1.26 / **+10.98**)—the gap *widens* on the harder set. A training-side anti-hub embedding sits in the same space already covered by re-ranking. The mechanism (scene over-encoding) points to background/region suppression, which is non-generalizable here (a dataset-specific scene) and overlaps prior pose-masked suppression. We therefore present negative in-degree as a **diagnostic**: it tells you *where* strong ReID fails and *why* (gallery topology / non-identity factor), while the *fix* remains the province of established test-time tools.

  1025	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1099:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:5168:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_1.txt:10:廉价 kill-switch：零训练先做三件事。下载 VeRi-776 或 VERI-Wild annotations，用 frozen Swin/CLIP/DINO/已有 ReID checkpoint 跑 seen/unseen type split；统计 top-k false positives 中同 model/color/type 的比例；再做一个 test-time 语义原型惩罚或 subtraction。如果 unseen mAP 没有明显改善，或错误不集中在同车型同色假阳性，直接杀。
  1026	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1127:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:7569:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:1886:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:14:一个 ReID 团队的 **Lattice-Marginalized ReID**(重定义: 低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性, 非'模糊缺细节')零训练 kill-switch = GO。证据: frozen 模型, K=9 phase/bbox/kernel variants 的 ensemble 在 h=16 LR query 上 +4.23 mAP, **比同 K 的普通随机 TTA 多 +3.04**(lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名: lat-MaxSim 46.9>tta 43.8>single 42.6), 74.9% LR query 跨 lattice 变体翻转 rank-1 身份(h升→31%→10%), 过 vs-TTA + vs-#false 双控。**诚实: phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器与 LR-severity 共线(correlational 弱), GO 靠 interventional ensemble 结果(直接测量)。**
  1027	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1132:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:8085:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:14:一个 ReID 团队的 **Lattice-Marginalized ReID**(重定义: 低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性, 非'模糊缺细节')零训练 kill-switch = GO。证据: frozen 模型, K=9 phase/bbox/kernel variants 的 ensemble 在 h=16 LR query 上 +4.23 mAP, **比同 K 的普通随机 TTA 多 +3.04**(lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名: lat-MaxSim 46.9>tta 43.8>single 42.6), 74.9% LR query 跨 lattice 变体翻转 rank-1 身份(h升→31%→10%), 过 vs-TTA + vs-#false 双控。**诚实: phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器与 LR-severity 共线(correlational 弱), GO 靠 interventional ensemble 结果(直接测量)。**
  1028	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1200:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:3963:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:4730:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10916:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:11752:从 Market/Occluded-Duke 中选高可见 target query `T` 和 donor 行人 `D`，把 donor 的人体 mask 或 bbox 贴到 `T` 上，生成 `M=T⊕D`。gallery 保持原始，里面同时有 target-ID 和 donor-ID。这样 donor 身份、target 身份、遮挡 mask 全部已知，但 eval 仍按 target pid 算。

  1031	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1628:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3684:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5843:reassess/r_3.md:8051:./reassess/r_3.md:5139:本地 exp109 的原始记录比当前叙述更细：oracle support bank 上界是强阳性，但它用 GT same-ID prototype，是“知道目标身份以后怎么补”的上界；这正是 donor-source-separation 必须绕开的墙。真正的 kill-switch 不能只测“泄漏能不能被检测”，必须在 frozen 特征上直接测“无 GT 身份、只按遮挡源压制后，排序是否上升”。

  1094	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:2509:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:15641:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:6955:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14:ReID 范式转向终局决策(调研交给你, 不判死, 帮选+审视可行性)。3 路 gap analysis 收敛: 遮挡 ReID 根问题=single-image support incomplete(项目 exp109 oracle 证 +8.5 mAP headroom)。两个最强候选二选一去 build: **#1 T-SCD(Temporal Support-Complete Distillation, 7.5/10)**: 训练用 occluded_posetrack tracklet(同 ID 多帧)构 support-complete teacher 蒸馏进单图 student, 测试单图。**#2 Intruder Identity Suppression(6.8/10)**: 遮挡重定义为另一行人身份泄漏进 target embedding, 训练合成 target+donor 显式压 donor-ID(GRL/adversarial)+clean-occluded consistency。**关键审视**: 项目 memory 记 exp109 的 +8.5 oracle headroom 是'identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙'(测试时不知 ID 没法 complete support; 三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/95.8%可见; 当年结论'别在 ReID 内部找机制')。问: (a)T-SCD 把 identity-conditioned support 放训练端(tracklet privileged info)蒸馏进单图 student, 是真绕过 exp109 测试端墙, 还是又撞同一堵墙(privileged distillation gap/student 学不会)? 诚实判断别捧场。(b)T-SCD vs Intruder 哪个更值得 build(野心×可行×novelty×B类×绕开项目死区)? (c)选定方向的最终 pipeline + 头号风险 + 头号 kill-switch(第一周能看的)。联网查 privileged/temporal distillation to single-image occluded ReID + identity source separation ReID 的 2024-26 novelty 先例。务实中文, 信心 1-10。

(c)选定方向的最终 pipeline + 头号风险 + 头号 kill-switch(第一周能看的)。联网查 privileged/temporal distillation to single-image occluded ReID + identity source separation ReID 的 2024-26 novelty 先例。务实中文, 信心 1-10。

  1196	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3145:exp360 Intruder Identity Suppression 阶段0 frozen probe 结果, 帮判方向(调研/决策交你, 别捧场)。机制: 遮挡 ReID 重定义为 donor 行人身份污染 target embedding, 训练端对抗压 donor-ID, 测试单图。**阶段0 frozen 强 baseline(market) 合成 target+donor**: H1 donor-ID linear probe acc 73% vs chance 2% = **36.5x PASS(泄漏巨大确凿)**; person leak 0.15 >> rand patch -0.01 PASS; **但 H2 FAIL: leak=cos(f_mix,f_donor)-cos(f_clean,f_donor) vs per-query AP drop, raw spearman +0.120, 控 #false-in-topk(top-k混错ID平凡代理)后 partial=-0.028 约0**。AP drop 大(clean 0.835→mix 0.409)。诚实含义: donor 泄漏存在且大, 但泄漏量不独立于 #false 预测检索损害。问: (a)H2 FAIL 是否**致命否定** Intruder 因果链(压泄漏→救检索)? 还是 H2(frozen per-query 相关)≠H3(训练干预), donor suppression 训练仍值得试? (c)若致命, 3候选回选下一个: B PSC-JEPA(从SOLIDER continued-pretrain pseudo-support-bank latent JEPA) / C-#3 support-set continued pretrain / 还是另起? 联网查 identity disentangle/feature purification/source separation occluded ReID 里'泄漏可测但压它未必涨'的先例教训(OGFR DPEFormer 等)。务实中文, 每选项信心1-10。

  1223	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3954:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:14:exp360 Intruder Identity Suppression 阶段0 frozen probe 结果, 帮判方向(调研/决策交你, 别捧场)。机制: 遮挡 ReID 重定义为 donor 行人身份污染 target embedding, 训练端对抗压 donor-ID, 测试单图。**阶段0 frozen 强 baseline(market) 合成 target+donor**: H1 donor-ID linear probe acc 73% vs chance 2% = **36.5x PASS(泄漏巨大确凿)**; person leak 0.15 >> rand patch -0.01 PASS; **但 H2 FAIL: leak=cos(f_mix,f_donor)-cos(f_clean,f_donor) vs per-query AP drop, raw spearman +0.120, 控 #false-in-topk(top-k混错ID平凡代理)后 partial=-0.028 约0**。AP drop 大(clean 0.835→mix 0.409)。诚实含义: donor 泄漏存在且大, 但泄漏量不独立于 #false 预测检索损害。问: (a)H2 FAIL 是否**致命否定** Intruder 因果链(压泄漏→救检索)? 还是 H2(frozen per-query 相关)≠H3(训练干预), donor suppression 训练仍值得试? (b)若值得试, 阶段1怎么设计让'压 donor-ID'真涨不退化成 target ambiguity 墙(KPR已占)? (c)若致命, 3候选回选下一个: B PSC-JEPA(从SOLIDER continued-pretrain pseudo-support-bank latent JEPA) / C-#3 support-set continued pretrain / 还是另起? 联网查 identity disentangle/feature purification/source separation occluded ReID 里'泄漏可测但压它未必涨'的先例教训(OGFR DPEFormer 等)。务实中文, 每选项信心1-10。

  1225	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3994:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:903:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20.sh:6:CTX="一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。"
  1226	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3998:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:972:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:14:一个 ReID 团队的 **Lattice-Marginalized ReID**(重定义: 低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性, 非'模糊缺细节')零训练 kill-switch = GO。证据: frozen 模型, K=9 phase/bbox/kernel variants 的 ensemble 在 h=16 LR query 上 +4.23 mAP, **比同 K 的普通随机 TTA 多 +3.04**(lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名: lat-MaxSim 46.9>tta 43.8>single 42.6), 74.9% LR query 跨 lattice 变体翻转 rank-1 身份(h升→31%→10%), 过 vs-TTA + vs-#false 双控。**诚实: phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器与 LR-severity 共线(correlational 弱), GO 靠 interventional ensemble 结果(直接测量)。**

  1289	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4066:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1099:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:5168:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_1.txt:10:廉价 kill-switch：零训练先做三件事。下载 VeRi-776 或 VERI-Wild annotations，用 frozen Swin/CLIP/DINO/已有 ReID checkpoint 跑 seen/unseen type split；统计 top-k false positives 中同 model/color/type 的比例；再做一个 test-time 语义原型惩罚或 subtraction。如果 unseen mAP 没有明显改善，或错误不集中在同车型同色假阳性，直接杀。
  1290	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4070:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1127:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:7569:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:1886:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:14:一个 ReID 团队的 **Lattice-Marginalized ReID**(重定义: 低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性, 非'模糊缺细节')零训练 kill-switch = GO。证据: frozen 模型, K=9 phase/bbox/kernel variants 的 ensemble 在 h=16 LR query 上 +4.23 mAP, **比同 K 的普通随机 TTA 多 +3.04**(lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名: lat-MaxSim 46.9>tta 43.8>single 42.6), 74.9% LR query 跨 lattice 变体翻转 rank-1 身份(h升→31%→10%), 过 vs-TTA + vs-#false 双控。**诚实: phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器与 LR-severity 共线(correlational 弱), GO 靠 interventional ensemble 结果(直接测量)。**

  1311	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5125:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22043:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4539:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2578:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:14:Review the files experiments/cargo_cvpb/maxsim_probe.py and experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py (CARGO aerial-ground person ReID, empirical CVPB method). afd_train.py 含 --ovp 的 OVPMemory: 每pid维护aerial/ground两个EMA原型(buffer[num_pid,2,2048] momentum0.2), InfoNCE把样本拉到自己pid的opposite-view原型(τ0.05 λ0.5), total=CE+triplet+λ·OVP。逐行查: bug/runtime/shape/device/AMP数值安全; EMA更新+InfoNCE+cold-start mask正确性; train/test对称; --ovp off是否精确复现baseline。用web search查novelty撞车: opposite-view/cross-view EMA prototype + InfoNCE 在 aerial-ground 或 person ReID 的先例(查 PDPA 2025 CARGO / CMPC / MBCE VI-ReID)。输出 Verdict(approve/needs-attention)+ findings(severity Critical/High/Medium/Low)。

  1313	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5295:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_4.txt:7:- 廉价 kill-switch：零训练可做。拿开源 VI checkpoint 或先训一个最小 baseline，在 SYSU/RegDB test split 中随机隐藏 20/50/80% 身份的 gallery 正样本，把对应 query 标成 absent。看 top-1 distance/margin 是否能区分 present vs absent；如果 AUROC 已经很高、FAR 很低，杀掉。若 re-ranking 提升 closed-set 却显著放大 absent false accept，这就是强证据。
  1314	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5297:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_5.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。

  1325	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5358:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_10.md:88:- 零训练 kill-switch：用 frozen SOLIDER/exp030a 特征，按 query-camera 到 gallery-camera 的 train support 分桶，算 pair-conditioned mAP/R1；控制 positive 数量、gallery size、occlusion 后，tail-pair 比 head-pair 仍低 5-8 mAP 才继续。再跑一次 2025 camera-specific feature normalization 后 gap 仍在，才说明不是普通 camera bias。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.10195))
  1326	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5359:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_10.md:96:- 零训练 kill-switch：用 Market/MSMT/CARGO 构造 Zipf arrival stream，frozen 特征跑 nearest-centroid/global-threshold/DBSCAN/k-reciprocal baseline。看 false-merge 是否随 head support count 单调上升；再测一个 support-calibrated threshold 是否在相同 known-ID recall 下显著降 tail false merge。若全局阈值已解决，直接杀。
  1327	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5360:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_10.md:107:- 零训练 kill-switch：用 frozen SOLIDER/exp030a 特征，按 query-camera 到 gallery-camera 的 train support 分桶，算 pair-conditioned mAP/R1；控制 positive 数量、gallery size、occlusion 后，tail-pair 比 head-pair 仍低 5-8 mAP 才继续。再跑一次 2025 camera-specific feature normalization 后 gap 仍在，才说明不是普通 camera bias。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.10195))
  1328	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5361:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_10.md:115:- 零训练 kill-switch：用 Market/MSMT/CARGO 构造 Zipf arrival stream，frozen 特征跑 nearest-centroid/global-threshold/DBSCAN/k-reciprocal baseline。看 false-merge 是否随 head support count 单调上升；再测一个 support-calibrated threshold 是否在相同 known-ID recall 下显著降 tail false merge。若全局阈值已解决，直接杀。
  1329	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5362:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_1.txt:10:廉价 kill-switch：零训练先做三件事。下载 VeRi-776 或 VERI-Wild annotations，用 frozen Swin/CLIP/DINO/已有 ReID checkpoint 跑 seen/unseen type split；统计 top-k false positives 中同 model/color/type 的比例；再做一个 test-time 语义原型惩罚或 subtraction。如果 unseen mAP 没有明显改善，或错误不集中在同车型同色假阳性，直接杀。
  1330	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5369:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_4.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。
  1331	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5371:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_4.md:86:- 廉价 kill-switch：零训练可做。拿开源 VI checkpoint 或先训一个最小 baseline，在 SYSU/RegDB test split 中随机隐藏 20/50/80% 身份的 gallery 正样本，把对应 query 标成 absent。看 top-1 distance/margin 是否能区分 present vs absent；如果 AUROC 已经很高、FAR 很低，杀掉。若 re-ranking 提升 closed-set 却显著放大 absent false accept，这就是强证据。

  1340	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5560:ReID 范式转向终局决策(调研交给你, 不判死, 帮选+审视可行性)。3 路 gap analysis 收敛: 遮挡 ReID 根问题=single-image support incomplete(项目 exp109 oracle 证 +8.5 mAP headroom)。两个最强候选二选一去 build: **#1 T-SCD(Temporal Support-Complete Distillation, 7.5/10)**: 训练用 occluded_posetrack tracklet(同 ID 多帧)构 support-complete teacher 蒸馏进单图 student, 测试单图。**#2 Intruder Identity Suppression(6.8/10)**: 遮挡重定义为另一行人身份泄漏进 target embedding, 训练合成 target+donor 显式压 donor-ID(GRL/adversarial)+clean-occluded consistency。**关键审视**: 项目 memory 记 exp109 的 +8.5 oracle headroom 是'identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙'(测试时不知 ID 没法 complete support; 三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/95.8%可见; 当年结论'别在 ReID 内部找机制')。问: (a)T-SCD 把 identity-conditioned support 放训练端(tracklet privileged info)蒸馏进单图 student, 是真绕过 exp109 测试端墙, 还是又撞同一堵墙(privileged distillation gap/student 学不会)? 诚实判断别捧场。(b)T-SCD vs Intruder 哪个更值得 build(野心×可行×novelty×B类×绕开项目死区)? (c)选定方向的最终 pipeline + 头号风险 + 头号 kill-switch(第一周能看的)。联网查 privileged/temporal distillation to single-image occluded ReID + identity source separation ReID 的 2024-26 novelty 先例。务实中文, 信心 1-10。

(c)选定方向的最终 pipeline + 头号风险 + 头号 kill-switch(第一周能看的)。联网查 privileged/temporal distillation to single-image occluded ReID + identity source separation ReID 的 2024-26 novelty 先例。务实中文, 信心 1-10。

  1417	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:6326:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:6955:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14:ReID 范式转向终局决策(调研交给你, 不判死, 帮选+审视可行性)。3 路 gap analysis 收敛: 遮挡 ReID 根问题=single-image support incomplete(项目 exp109 oracle 证 +8.5 mAP headroom)。两个最强候选二选一去 build: **#1 T-SCD(Temporal Support-Complete Distillation, 7.5/10)**: 训练用 occluded_posetrack tracklet(同 ID 多帧)构 support-complete teacher 蒸馏进单图 student, 测试单图。**#2 Intruder Identity Suppression(6.8/10)**: 遮挡重定义为另一行人身份泄漏进 target embedding, 训练合成 target+donor 显式压 donor-ID(GRL/adversarial)+clean-occluded consistency。**关键审视**: 项目 memory 记 exp109 的 +8.5 oracle headroom 是'identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙'(测试时不知 ID 没法 complete support; 三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/95.8%可见; 当年结论'别在 ReID 内部找机制')。问: (a)T-SCD 把 identity-conditioned support 放训练端(tracklet privileged info)蒸馏进单图 student, 是真绕过 exp109 测试端墙, 还是又撞同一堵墙(privileged distillation gap/student 学不会)? 诚实判断别捧场。(b)T-SCD vs Intruder 哪个更值得 build(野心×可行×novelty×B类×绕开项目死区)? (c)选定方向的最终 pipeline + 头号风险 + 头号 kill-switch(第一周能看的)。联网查 privileged/temporal distillation to single-image occluded ReID + identity source separation ReID 的 2024-26 novelty 先例。务实中文, 信心 1-10。

  1429	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:6343:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:15143:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14:ReID 范式转向终局决策(调研交给你, 不判死, 帮选+审视可行性)。3 路 gap analysis 收敛: 遮挡 ReID 根问题=single-image support incomplete(项目 exp109 oracle 证 +8.5 mAP headroom)。两个最强候选二选一去 build: **#1 T-SCD(Temporal Support-Complete Distillation, 7.5/10)**: 训练用 occluded_posetrack tracklet(同 ID 多帧)构 support-complete teacher 蒸馏进单图 student, 测试单图。**#2 Intruder Identity Suppression(6.8/10)**: 遮挡重定义为另一行人身份泄漏进 target embedding, 训练合成 target+donor 显式压 donor-ID(GRL/adversarial)+clean-occluded consistency。**关键审视**: 项目 memory 记 exp109 的 +8.5 oracle headroom 是'identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙'(测试时不知 ID 没法 complete support; 三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/95.8%可见; 当年结论'别在 ReID 内部找机制')。问: (a)T-SCD 把 identity-conditioned support 放训练端(tracklet privileged info)蒸馏进单图 student, 是真绕过 exp109 测试端墙, 还是又撞同一堵墙(privileged distillation gap/student 学不会)? 诚实判断别捧场。(b)T-SCD vs Intruder 哪个更值得 build(野心×可行×novelty×B类×绕开项目死区)? (c)选定方向的最终 pipeline + 头号风险 + 头号 kill-switch(第一周能看的)。联网查 privileged/temporal distillation to single-image occluded ReID + identity source separation ReID 的 2024-26 novelty 先例。务实中文, 信心 1-10。
  1430	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:6344:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:15158:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:2929:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4448:./reassess/r_3.md:5139:本地 exp109 的原始记录比当前叙述更细：oracle support bank 上界是强阳性，但它用 GT same-ID prototype，是“知道目标身份以后怎么补”的上界；这正是 donor-source-separation 必须绕开的墙。真正的 kill-switch 不能只测“泄漏能不能被检测”，必须在 frozen 特征上直接测“无 GT 身份、只按遮挡源压制后，排序是否上升”。

  1648	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9306:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5830:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object).   1671	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9329:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7886:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1888:./reviews/deep_25.md:14099:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MFE 先在 ViT patch 上做 intra-patch 和 inter-patch 编码，补足 patch 内外层级信息。PPM 不做 pose-to-global，而是把 pose 和 patch 当成两种模态，用 Mahalanobis distance 加 cosine similarity 建 pose-patch 相似矩阵，只保留高置信关键点对应的 patch，从而降低局部 pose 错误的全局污染。TAD 再用 context extraction layer 和 texture extraction layer，以 PPM 过滤后的 pose 特征为约束，通过 cross-attention 强化可区分纹理。pose loss 还约束人体和非人体映射特征不要太相似。机制和两个失败场景绑定得比较紧。

  1786	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9444:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:11021:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3020:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1528:3. 机制怎么长出来：机制基本是顺着这个重定义长出来的。主体 token S* 来自全局图像特征，表示“这是谁”；属性 token A* 由 learnable queries 从 patch 中提取可见身份属性；上下文 token O* 提取遮挡物特征。三者组成 “A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*]” 这样的细粒度 prompt，再用文本作为 query 对视觉 patch 做 cross-attention，引导图像特征看可见人体区域、压掉遮挡物。动态融合用预测不确定性给 visual、text、cross-attention feature 分配权重，是对可靠性问题的补强。
  1787	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9445:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:11030:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3151:../litreview/reviews/lit_17.md:3140:cheap kill-switch：先在少量 AG-ReID/CARGO 样本上跑现有 SMPL/pose 管线，冻结 SOLIDER，只做 mesh surface pooling。若 SMPL 投影在航拍上失败率高，或同一表面区域的跨视角相似度不优于普通 patch/pose part，直接止损。

  1817	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9475:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:15063:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask.   1839	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9497:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:16072:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1613:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_28.md:6936:关键消融是三组。第一，只用 LVLM 的 visual model 做 baseline 效果低，说明单纯视觉 tokens 不够。第二，把 LVLM 生成的 semantic token 换成随机 learnable token 后明显掉点，说明 `<REID>` token 的语义来源有用，不只是多了一个 class token。第三，去掉 SGI 后效果也掉，说明 token 需要和视觉 tokens 交互，而不是直接拿生成 token 检索。CSS 的消融显示把相机语义放到输入 patch embedding 比放到 `<REID>` token 后面更好，说明相机偏移要早处理。检索可视化显示 baseline 容易被颜色、衣服、姿态误导，而语义 token 引导后能抓住图案、配饰和遮挡下的细节。推理时间从 784ms 到 906ms 处理 64 张图，用来缓解“LVLM 太慢”的质疑。

  1904	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9562:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17929:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4400:./reassess/r_3.md:4482:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:21:"mechanism": "TTPM is a ViT + HRNet pipeline with three parts and no occlusion-sample augmentation. A Multi-patch Feature Encoder encodes intra-patch and inter-patch features (re-grouping patches at 2x scale with the cls token). Pose-Patch Mapping (PPM) builds a fine-grained, per-patch positional correspondence between M pose keypoints and N patches via a learned similarity S = gamma*D_M - eta*S_M that combines an affine-extended Mahalanobis distance and affine-extended cosine similarity, gates out low-confidence keypoints by a heatmap-confidence threshold, and selects the argmax-similarity patch per keypoint, thereby down-weighting occluded patches without coarse global pose mapping. A Texture-Aware Decoder (context-extraction MHSA layers + texture-extraction MHCA layers using pose-filtered features as queries) leverages texture distinctiveness to separate the target from non-target pedestrian occluders. An auxiliary pose loss penalizes high cosine similarity between human-part and non-human (background) features.",
  1905	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9563:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17930:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4401:./reassess/r_3.md:4483:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:22:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas for occluded ReID. (1) The pose loss L_p that explicitly minimizes cosine similarity between body-part features and non-human/background features — a cheap regularizer to suppress occluder/background leakage into the identity embedding, applicable to any pose- or part-based occluded model. (2) The texture-distinctiveness decoder channel aimed specifically at non-target PEDESTRIAN occlusion: when the occluder is itself a person, pose/structure cues fail (same skeleton topology), so using texture appearance distinctiveness (via pose-filtered queries cross-attending to contextual features) to push apart target vs distractor-person is a concrete mechanism for the under-addressed person-on-person occlusion case. Also transferable: replacing coarse pose-to-global mapping with a per-keypoint-to-patch confidence-gated argmax correspondence (Mahalanobis+cosine affine similarity) to localize visible regions.",
  1906	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9564:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17931:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
  1907	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9565:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17932:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4403:./reassess/r_3.md:4491:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:86:"transfer_to_occluded": "Apply the text-level orthogonal-projection disentanglement to occlusion: learn a dual prompt for the OCCLUDER/distractor (e.g. \"a photo of the [X]...[X] occluder\") alongside the ID prompt, then orthogonalize the occluder text feature out of the ID text feature (F_ort = F_id - proj of F_occ onto F_id) and use the purged ID text feature to guide the visual encoder via the non-local SIM. Because the non-local operation aggregates from spatially distant but semantically relevant regions, it is well suited to occluded ReID where visible body parts are scattered far from the occluded/corrupted region — letting the model pull ID evidence from non-adjacent visible patches rather than local self-attention that gets dominated by the occluder. The orthogonalization gives a clean way to subtract a known nuisance direction (occluder appearance) without an auxiliary parser.",
  1908	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9566:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17933:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4405:./reassess/r_3.md:4493:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion.   1967	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9625:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:18199:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5830:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight.   2102	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_1.txt:10:廉价 kill-switch：零训练先做三件事。下载 VeRi-776 或 VERI-Wild annotations，用 frozen Swin/CLIP/DINO/已有 ReID checkpoint 跑 seen/unseen type split；统计 top-k false positives 中同 model/color/type 的比例；再做一个 test-time 语义原型惩罚或 subtraction。如果 unseen mAP 没有明显改善，或错误不集中在同车型同色假阳性，直接杀。
  2103	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_20.txt:4:**触发观察/失败**：标准 ReID 默认 query 是单张正确目标，multi-query 默认多张全是同一 ID。真实部署里更常见的是“用户/检索员给一包候选截图”，其中可能混入跟踪漂移、检测错框、相邻行人、错误截图。大家以为“query support 越多越稳”，其实隐藏变量可能是 **query-bag purity**：多给错图会比单图更坏。
  2104	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_2.txt:21:触发观察：CC-ReID 统一算 mAP/Rank-1，但不是每张换衣 query 都有足够身份信息。正面脸、清晰头部、稳定肢体、鞋包 carry-over、多视角 support 都会极大改变可匹配性。很多失败不是模型不够强，而是单图证据不足。
  2105	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_2.txt:25:机制草案：`Biometric Evidence Routing`。为 query-gallery 对构建 cue support：face/head visible、limb visible、body contour quality、artifact volatility、same-clothes support、gallery support density。高证据走对应 cue expert；低证据样本输出低置信或请求 set-query/tracklet/人工复核。训练端可用 evidence-conditioned contrastive：只在共同可见且可靠 cue 上拉近，不对低证据样本过度监督。
  2106	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_2.txt:29:2. 对 PRCC/LTCC/DeepChange query 按 evidence 分桶，看低 evidence 桶是否贡献主要 false top-k。
  2107	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_10.txt:5:- 重定义：把 long-tail 从 `identity frequency` 改成 `identity-camera-pair edge / camera-transition support`。大家以为长尾是类频次，其实在 ReID 里关键是“某些跨摄像头转换从训练到测试都没被充分覆盖”。
  2108	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_10.txt:6:- 机制草案：构建 camera-pair support graph；batch/loss 按低支持 camera-pair 采样和加权；约束不同 camera-pair support bin 的 positive margin 分布一致。不要讲 camera-bias normalization，要讲“跨摄像头证据覆盖不均”。
  2109	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_10.txt:7:- 零训练 kill-switch：用 frozen SOLIDER/exp030a 特征，按 query-camera 到 gallery-camera 的 train support 分桶，算 pair-conditioned mAP/R1；控制 positive 数量、gallery size、occlusion 后，tail-pair 比 head-pair 仍低 5-8 mAP 才继续。再跑一次 2025 camera-specific feature normalization 后 gap 仍在，才说明不是普通 camera bias。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.10195))

  2114	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_9.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。

  2151	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_4.md:85:- 机制草案：用 Swin/SOLIDER 做 VI backbone，增加 `existence/energy` 头。训练时做 episodic gallery dropout：对部分训练身份故意移除跨模态正样本，构造 no-match episode；再用 nearest impostor 做 hard negative，学习“有跨模态证据才接受”。评测报 closed-set mAP/R1 + `DIR@FAR`、AUROC、false accept rate。
  2152	experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_4.md:86:- 廉价 kill-switch：零训练可做。拿开源 VI checkpoint 或先训一个最小 baseline，在 SYSU/RegDB test split 中随机隐藏 20/50/80% 身份的 gallery 正样本，把对应 query 标成 absent。看 top-1 distance/margin 是否能区分 present vs absent；如果 AUROC 已经很高、FAR 很低，杀掉。若 re-ranking 提升 closed-set 却显著放大 absent false accept，这就是强证据。

./experiments/decisions.md:4434:**理由**：LR4≈LR8（非显著 underfit），LR2 严重 underfit -5.3。PLBOA 在 Occ-Duke +2.2-2.7 mAP，但 Market→Occ-ReID 跨域 -25.4 mAP（exp293 vs exp269）。
./experiments/decisions.md:4540:**资产**: 现成 Market-trained ckpt `log/market1501/exp260b_base_gcn512_2stage/transformer_120.pth`(Swin-Base+PSG+LGPA+GCN512), 现成跨域 eval `test_on_occluded_reid.py`(Market→Occluded-ReID 86.0/88.5 已存), 两域数据+pose 齐。脚本 `scripts/uce_calib_probe.py`, 结果 `log/uce_calib_probe.json`。
./experiments/decisions.md:4541:**方法(无训练)**: 同一 ckpt 提 L2-normed equal_concat 特征, in-domain=Market test(3368q/15913g), cross-domain=Occluded-ReID(1000q/1000g); 按 Market metric(去同 pid+同 cam)算 genuine/impostor 余弦相似度直方图; 报 d'/AUROC/EER/EER 阈值 + **阈值迁移测试**(源域 EER 阈值搬到目标域看 FAR/FRR)。
./experiments/decisions.md:4543:  - In-domain Market: gen=0.886±0.067 imp=0.365±0.091 **d'=6.51 AUROC=0.9983 EER=0.95% thr@EER=0.636**
./experiments/decisions.md:4545:  - **阈值迁移**: 源阈值 0.636 → 目标 0.642, **shift 仅 +0.006**; 把源 Market 阈值直接搬到目标 OccReID: **FAR=4.06% FRR=3.14%**(vs 目标原生 EER 3.65%)——几乎零代价。
./experiments/decisions.md:4551:**资产**: Market-trained ckpt `log/market1501/exp260b_base_gcn512_2stage/transformer_120.pth`(Swin-Base+PSG+LGPA+GCN512, Occ-ReID baseline 88.0 mAP MaxSim+flip), 数据 Occluded-ReID(1000q/1000g+pose), env solider-reid(torch1.13+mmcv)。脚本 `scripts/vcnorm_probe.py`(主)+`scripts/vcnorm_probe_control.py`(对照), 结果 `experiments/vcnorm_probe/*.json` + README。
./experiments/decisions.md:4560:**决策**: VC-Norm **PROCEED**(整夜多线首个非 kill 信号)。下一步若推进: 1-2d dual-forward Market 30ep(occluded/clean 两路 forward, per-part-token visibility-conditioned 对齐归一化统计), **目标 Occ-ReID mAP > 88.0**, 30ep 短训当 kill-switch 不涨即止损。是否开训待用户拍板。诚实呈现, 不夸大为已验证。
./experiments/decisions.md:4592:**结果**: VC-Norm vs control 跨域全变体 −3.3 mAP(global 77.3/80.6, part_only 79.3/82.7, equal_concat 77.5/80.9)。**VC-Norm 在真遮挡跨域上显著伤**(Market 学的对齐 transform 跨域误用)。
./experiments/decisions.md:4594:**理由**: −3.3 显著、VCA 已激活 20ep、e120 反转极低概率。Market −0.6 + 跨域 −3.3 双向伤。
./experiments/decisions.md:4691:**上下文**: 三个独立 codex(终身 d3 / 开集 d9 / 长尾 d10)收敛到同一 re-framing: ReID 失败由 GALLERY 组成(规模/膨胀/分布)驱动, 非只看 query/模型。用户要求零训练验证, ★铁律=每个 per-query 相关都控 trivial 代理(吸取 HUBNESS §7.6 教训: 上个诊断被漏控 #false-in-topk 证伪)。脚本 `cvpb_gallery_killswitch.py`, 复用 hubness 缓存特征, Market exp260b + Occluded-Duke exp255。双审(Claude broad 5 blocking 全修 + Codex)。
./experiments/decisions.md:4694:- **测试 A Gallery-Growth Tax = LIVE**: frozen 模型旧 query mAP 随同域 gallery 膨胀结构性下降(Market 1x→10x −4.4, **OD −12.9**, 量级≈LReID 报的 forgetting)。CONTROL1(#false-in-topk, 杀 Hubness 的代理): ρ(−dAP,d#false)+0.74 大部分是 trivial 计数, 但"#false 完全不变"子集仍 −1.2(Market)/−2.6(OD) mAP, partial(OD)+0.28——结构成分过了致命代理。CONTROL2 ★决定性: real distractor −4.45(Market)/−13.16(OD) vs 列洗牌毁方向同 count −0.00 → tax 是结构性(distractor 身份几何咬人), 非机械 count。
./experiments/decisions.md:4695:- **测试 B Gallery-Size Rejection = DEAD**: impostor max 随 watchlist size 升(REAL ρ+1.0)但 random-feature null 升一样猛(纯 max-of-N 极值)。CAL/EVAL 折去循环后净增益(REAL−RANDOM)drift-red −0.245(Market)/−0.282(OD) 为负。强 backbone 上 genuine~0.97/impostor~0.5 近完全可分, 拒识饱和, size-conditioning 表观增益全在 EVT trivial floor。
./experiments/decisions.md:4700:**执行(待办)**: A 当前是诊断, remedy(distractor-aware continual training)未验证, 需独立实验且警惕撞 backward-compatible LReID(arxiv 2403.10022)。诚实写明 CONTROL2 是主证据(CONTROL1 的结构残差 Market partial 仅+0.05 偏弱)。跨 backbone 普适性 + 与 re-rank 互补性未测。交付=`cvpb_gallery_result.md` 原始数字。

./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:3:> **来源**：post-PRCV「搬范式 / 重定义问题」路线。前置探针 `scripts/vcnorm_probe.py`（commit e3a709b）已证前提成立：在 Market 全可见训练的 exp260b 模型上，Occluded-ReID 被遮挡部位的 per-part GCN token 归一化统计（per-channel mean/var）漂到与可见 token 明显不同、近完美线性可分的区（pre-GCN KL≈288 / LDA-AUC≈0.97，post-GCN 仍 KL 数十 / AUC≈0.8），且 3 个对照证明不是采样伪影。**遮挡 = 未对齐的 domain factor**。
./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:5:> **baseline**：exp260b（Swin-Base + 2-stage PSG + LGPA-D + GCN512 + OA-SD + PLBOA），Market 训练 → Occluded-ReID 跨域 = **88.0 mAP（MaxSim + flip）**。目标 **> 88.0**。
./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:9:exp260b 已有 OA-SD（occluded student ↔ clean EMA teacher 双前向）+ PLBOA（下肢遮挡增广），但其蒸馏只作用在 **pooled global 特征**（cosine）。BT-PKD 进一步蒸馏 per-keypoint 特征**方向**（cosine），仍是「让被遮挡 token 的特征向 clean token 看齐」。两者都没有触碰探针指认的真正病灶：**被遮挡 per-part token 的归一化统计（一阶/二阶矩）整体漂移到一个可分离的子空间**——这是一条「有/无遮挡」的 domain 轴，叠加在身份信号上。OA-SD/BT-PKD 把个体特征拉近，但没有显式消掉这条 domain 轴；探针显示这条轴在跨域时大量残留（pre-GCN AUC 0.97），GCN 只部分修复。
./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:15:在 exp260b 的 dual-forward（occluded student / clean teacher）之上，对 GCN 的 17 个 per-keypoint token 加一个 **VisibilityConditionedNorm（VCN）模块** + **可见性条件统计对齐 loss（VCA）**：训练时把 student 路被遮挡 token 的 per-keypoint per-channel 归一化统计对齐到 teacher（clean）路同 keypoint 的统计，能消掉「遮挡 domain 轴」、让 visible-part 表示对有/无遮挡鲁棒，从而把 Market→Occluded-ReID 跨域 mAP 抬过 88.0。
./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:61:   - **复用现成 dual-forward**：exp260b 已是 `parallel_oa_sd`（3 occluded student + 1 clean teacher），teacher 前向已在 OA-SD 段算出 `teacher_kp_data`，**VCA 不新增前向、不增显存峰值的额外 backbone pass**。
./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:82:- **成立**：Occluded-ReID（Market→跨域）mAP/R1 > 88.0/baseline；日志里 VCA 的「对齐前矩距离 > 对齐后矩距离」单调改善，gamma/beta 不塌缩（std>0）；Market 同分布性能不掉（对齐不抹身份的证据）。
./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:84:  1. **抹身份**：对齐项把 per-keypoint 统计拉太狠，连身份信号一起压平 → Market 同分布 mAP 掉、跨域也不涨。30ep kill-switch：看 `id_part` CE 是否异常升高、Market e30 eval 是否低于 baseline e30。
./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:93:  - VC-Norm 净增益**只能 vs 这条对照**，**不能 vs 原 exp260b 88.0**（后者 PLBOA=False，是另一条 baseline）。
./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:94:- **PLBOA 说明（重要）**：exp260b 原 config `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=False`，此时 OA-SD 的 teacher≈student（代码已 warning「near-identical images」），OA-SD 近退化。VC-Norm 要 occluded-vs-clean 的对比信号**必须开 PLBOA**，故本实验与对照都设 `POSE_LOWER_BODY_OCC=True`。因此严格单变量对照是「同 PLBOA、VC-Norm 开/关」，**不是** vs 原 exp260b 88.0（后者 PLBOA 关）。88.0 仅作量级参照；若开 PLBOA 的 VC-Norm-OFF 对照已偏离 88.0，以对照为准。
./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:101:- 30ep：Market 同分布 mAP 不掉 + 跨域趋势 ≥ baseline + VCA 矩距离单调下降 + gamma/beta 不塌缩 → 跑满 120ep。
./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:102:- 反之（Market 掉 / 跨域不涨 / 对齐塌缩）→ 记录止损，最可能结论是「per-part 统计对齐在判别性-互补性张力下抹身份」，回 `research_directions.md`。
./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:108:  1. **Market 同分布 e30 eval**：若 VC-Norm 抹身份，Market（全可见、无 domain shift）mAP 会**先掉**——这是最灵敏的探针，因为 Market 没有要对齐的 domain 轴，任何掉分都是判别性损伤。
./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:112:- 任一信号异常（Market 掉 >0.5 mAP / id_part 持续升 / gamma 爆 / 矩距离骤塌）→ 30ep 止损。

./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/monitor.md:17:**趋势**: VC-Norm 在 Market(整体集)上稳定低对照 ~0.6-1.0 = VCN 模块在无遮挡数据上的小成本(符合预期, 无可对齐的遮挡 token)。gap 不扩大 → VCA 不伤整体。真正判据仍是跨域 Occ-ReID(训练完)。
./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/monitor.md:33:- **机制**: VCN 的遮挡-stat 对齐在 Market(训练域)上学的 transform，跨域到 Occ-ReID **误用→伤**(domain-specific 不迁移)。Market 整体 −0.6 + 跨域 −3.3 → VC-Norm 双向伤。
./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/monitor.md:41:- Market(整体集, 无遮挡)上 VC-Norm −1.0 vs control。**符合预期**：Market 无遮挡 → VC-Norm 的遮挡-stat 对齐无处发力，只显 VCN 模块小成本。
./experiments/exp328_vcnorm/monitor.md:43:- **真正判据 = 训练完跨域 Occluded-ReID eval**（有真遮挡），非 Market。训练用 PLBOA 合成遮挡，VCA 对齐合成遮挡 token，收益只在遮挡测试集显现。

./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:1442:- **测试 A Gallery-Growth Tax = LIVE**: frozen 模型旧 query mAP 随同域 gallery 膨胀结构性下降(Market 1x→10x −4.4, **OD −12.9**, 量级≈LReID 报的 forgetting)。CONTROL1(#false-in-topk, 杀 Hubness 的代理): ρ(−dAP,d#false)+0.74 大部分是 trivial 计数, 但"#false 完全不变"子集仍 −1.2(Market)/−2.6(OD) mAP, partial(OD)+0.28——结构成分过了致命代理。CONTROL2 ★决定性: real distractor −4.45(Market)/−13.16(OD) vs 列洗牌毁方向同 count −0.00 → tax 是结构性(distractor 身份几何咬人), 非机械 count。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:1443:- **测试 B Gallery-Size Rejection = DEAD**: impostor max 随 watchlist size 升(REAL ρ+1.0)但 random-feature null 升一样猛(纯 max-of-N 极值)。CAL/EVAL 折去循环后净增益(REAL−RANDOM)drift-red −0.245(Market)/−0.282(OD) 为负。强 backbone 上 genuine~0.97/impostor~0.5 近完全可分, 拒识饱和, size-conditioning 表观增益全在 EVT trivial floor。

./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:3419:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:5736:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:7013:validate/v_3.md:1723:../codex_review_raw.txt:4434:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:3420:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:5737:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:7014:validate/v_3.md:1761:../codex_review_raw.txt:4966:./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. ./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:5379:ReID 训练端范式级创新评估(重大转向, 明确不要 cheap 不要判死)。背景: 遮挡 ReID 项目守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块训练端已 100% 实测穷尽。用户授权换量级, 可不 cheap 花周级时间。**算力: 4 单卡 slot(4090 24G/3090 24G/5060Ti 16G×2), 无 from-scratch foundation model 算力**。数据: occluded_duke/market/msmt17/occluded_reid/occluded_posetrack。**评估范式=生成式数据引擎**(diffusion SD/ControlNet + pose/SMPL/depth 控制造大规模 ID-consistent 跨视角跨遮挡合成 ReID 训练数据训 backbone)。问: (a)Pose2ID(2024)/GAN-DG 之后, '生成数据当大规模训练源'范式还有什么真 novelty(可控遮挡合成 occlusion-curriculum? 无限合成 ID 解决数据稀缺? sim2real domain-gap 系统方法? identity-disentangled generation?)? (b)我 4-slot 单卡(diffusion 造数据数天可累积)能 actually build 的最有野心版本(pipeline: 生成模型+控制+造多少+怎么训)? (c)避开 Pose2ID/DG-Market/各种 ReID-GAN-aug, 联网查 2024-26 generative-ReID novelty。**不判死, 选最能 build 方案+pipeline+工作量(天/周)+风险+B类以上潜力。信心 1-10。务实中文。**

./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pivot_decision.md:7435:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:936:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:76:We tested the obvious remedies and report them honestly. A zero-training hub penalty `score' = cos − λ·log(1+H_k)` gives only +0.31 (Market) / +1.51 (Occluded-Duke) mAP, and is **dominated** by same-camera down-weighting (+0.67 / +3.13) and k-reciprocal (+1.26 / **+10.98**)—the gap *widens* on the harder set. A training-side anti-hub embedding sits in the same space already covered by re-ranking. The mechanism (scene over-encoding) points to background/region suppression, which is non-generalizable here (a dataset-specific scene) and overlaps prior pose-masked suppression. We therefore present negative in-degree as a **diagnostic**: it tells you *where* strong ReID fails and *why* (gallery topology / non-identity factor), while the *fix* remains the province of established test-time tools.

./experiments/exp253/claude_review.md:209:exp253 is a clean config-only ablation experiment. The code in `pose_backbone_model.py` correctly handles 3-stage PSG injection: stage indices resolve correctly, PSG modules are created with the right feature dimensions per stage, PatchMerging downsamples are applied after PSG injection at each stage, and heatmap interpolation adapts to each stage's spatial resolution. No code modifications needed. Memory usage will be less than exp251 (which ran successfully at 5542 MiB) because PAA is removed. Safe to launch.

./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_raw_stageb_r1.md:3594:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_ANALYSIS.md:8:强 ReID(Swin/SOLIDER, Market 94.6 / Occluded-Duke 73)仍有残差失败。大家默认失败来自"某个 query 没匹配好"(pairwise similarity 病)。**重定义: 强 ReID 的残差失败是 gallery topology 的 many-to-one 吸附——少数 gallery 图像成为很多不同身份 query 的误吸附点(negative in-degree hub)。** ReID 不是独立 pair matching, 是 directed kNN graph retrieval; 隐藏变量 = gallery 的负向 in-degree, 不是 hard-negative distance(hard 对一个 anchor 近; hub 对很多不同身份都近)。
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_raw_stageb_r1.md:3694:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6159:Strong supervised ReID is often treated as "solved" on Market (94+ mAP). Yet a residual of queries fail even with state-of-the-art backbones. The dominant framing treats each failure as an isolated **pairwise** problem—this query's feature is not close enough to its gallery match. We argue the residual failure is better understood as a **directed kNN-graph** property of the gallery: **a few gallery images become attraction hubs for many queries of unrelated identities** (many-to-one). The hidden variable is the gallery's **negative in-degree**, distinct from hard-negative distance (hard = close to *one* anchor; hub = close to *many different identities*).

./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_raw_stageb_r1.md:4162:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_6.md:71:用 Market/MSMT/AG-ReID.v2/CARGO 的 person ID 合成 3-5 人 group：构造链式样本 A-B positive、B-C positive、A-C negative；再构造 hard negatives：共享最显眼 1 人但总体 overlap 不足。比较 mean-pool group feature、max/Hungarian、k-reciprocal pooled feature、partial-OT overlap estimator。若 partial-OT 不能明显降低链式矛盾率和“共享单 anchor 假阳性”，或 mAP/R1 不比简单 Hungarian 高 1-2 点以上，直接杀。

./experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:950:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1023:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4632:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:8892:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:43:We tested the obvious remedies and report them honestly. A zero-training hub penalty `score' = cos − λ·log(1+H_k)` gives only +0.31 (Market) / +1.51 (Occluded-Duke) mAP, and is **dominated** by same-camera down-weighting (+0.67 / +3.13) and k-reciprocal (+1.26 / **+10.98**)—the gap *widens* on the harder set. A training-side anti-hub embedding sits in the same space already covered by re-ranking. The mechanism (scene over-encoding) points to background/region suppression, which is non-generalizable here (a dataset-specific scene) and overlaps prior pose-masked suppression. We therefore present negative in-degree as a **diagnostic**: it tells you *where* strong ReID fails and *why* (gallery topology / non-identity factor), while the *fix* remains the province of established test-time tools.

A training-side anti-hub embedding sits in the same space already covered by re-ranking. ./experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:1326:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5359:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_10.md:96:- 零训练 kill-switch：用 Market/MSMT/CARGO 构造 Zipf arrival stream，frozen 特征跑 nearest-centroid/global-threshold/DBSCAN/k-reciprocal baseline。看 false-merge 是否随 head support count 单调上升；再测一个 support-calibrated threshold 是否在相同 known-ID recall 下显著降 tail false merge。若全局阈值已解决，直接杀。
./experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:1328:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5361:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_10.md:115:- 零训练 kill-switch：用 Market/MSMT/CARGO 构造 Zipf arrival stream，frozen 特征跑 nearest-centroid/global-threshold/DBSCAN/k-reciprocal baseline。看 false-merge 是否随 head support count 单调上升；再测一个 support-calibrated threshold 是否在相同 known-ID recall 下显著降 tail false merge。若全局阈值已解决，直接杀。
./experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:1527:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:708:连续 rho 只 ~+0.25（被大量 M=0 query 稀释, 5 箱里 3 箱 M≈0）, 但**分箱趋势干净**: 高 M(q) query 正是 k-reciprocal 修复增益最大的（OD 4.3×, Market 4.5×, 两集一致）。→ **P4 reframe 在分箱意义上成立**: "M(q) 标记了现成 re-rank 工具受益最大的 query"。这是验证后唯一仍站得住、可写的正向叙事（但注意 §P0c: M 此处可能也只是 `#false-in-topk` 的代理, reframe 同样可用 #false 复述, 严谨写作需在 P4 也加 `#false` 对照)。
./experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_review.md:1528:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:9186:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:711:~~M(q) 干净解释 AP 误差(rho+0.60, 控代理后仍在)~~ → **修订**: (1) rho+0.60/+0.65 含 circular self-loop, 去 circular（LOO/held-out）后降到 +0.33（OD）/+0.25（Market）; (2) **决定性**: 控 trivial 代理 `#false-in-topk` 后 M(q) 偏相关 ≈0（两集一致 −0.06/−0.05）, 即"gallery 负向 in-degree / 拓扑"框架相对"top-k 里错几个"无增量解释力——原 D3 漏控了这个最致命代理; (3) P3 机制只半支持（去背景 −47%, 但去人 −87% 反更大, 非纯场景因子）; (4) **唯一仍正向**: P4 高 M(q) query 正是 k-reciprocal 修复最多的（分箱 4.3×/4.5×, 两集一致）。→ **作为"诊断变量"的 headline 站不住**（被 trivial 代理吃掉）; 若要保留, 只能定位成"M(q)/负向 in-degree 标记 re-rank 高收益 query"的弱 reframe, 且必须诚实写明它相对 `#false-in-topk` 无增量。**当前形态不足以撑 analysis short 的核心 claim。**

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/remedy_rethink.md:14:一个 ReID 团队的 **Gallery-Growth Tax** 诊断 LIVE(frozen 强 ReID 模型旧 query mAP 随同域 gallery 膨胀结构性掉点 Market−4.4/OD−12.9, CONTROL2 shuffle 证结构性)。但 remedy 草案 Tax-Aware Distractor Training(优化 gallery-size-conditioned extreme-negative risk)的零训练预检 = **分裂**: 饱和域 Market GO(extreme-negative margin 明显超 trivial 难度分), 但难/未饱和域 OD NO-GO(margin ≈ trivial 1x-top1-margin, extreme-negative 项无独立信号)。**诊断: OD 的 gallery-growth 失败是 weak-positive driven(occluded query 自身匹配弱), 非 strong-distractor driven**, 所以 distractor-targeting remedy 在最需要的难域塌回 trivial, 且救 weak-positive 撞 occlusion 死区。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/remedy_rethink.md:87:你的零训练预检已经把关键矛盾打出来了：Market 是 strong-distractor / extreme-negative regime，OD 是 weak-positive regime。对 OD 而言，extreme-negative margin ≈ trivial 1x-top1-margin，说明这个 loss 没有独立信号，继续训大概率只是把普通 hard mining / AP surrogate 换个名字。文献上 large-gallery 确实是 ReID 真实问题，且大 gallery 会因 appearance ambiguity 掉性能([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1812.03282))；但 occluded ReID 的主问题常被归到 missing information、misalignment、noise 等正样本证据不足([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.14452))，这支持你的 OD 诊断。

./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pscjepa_diagnosis.md:1850:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:42:Strong supervised ReID is often treated as "solved" on Market (94+ mAP). Yet a residual of queries fail even with state-of-the-art backbones. The dominant framing treats each failure as an isolated **pairwise** problem—this query's feature is not close enough to its gallery match. We argue the residual failure is better understood as a **directed kNN-graph** property of the gallery: **a few gallery images become attraction hubs for many queries of unrelated identities** (many-to-one). The hidden variable is the gallery's **negative in-degree**, distinct from hard-negative distance (hard = close to *one* anchor; hub = close to *many different identities*).
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pscjepa_diagnosis.md:1851:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:97:强 ReID(Swin/SOLIDER, Market 94.6 / Occluded-Duke 73)仍有残差失败。大家默认失败来自"某个 query 没匹配好"(pairwise similarity 病)。**重定义: 强 ReID 的残差失败是 gallery topology 的 many-to-one 吸附——少数 gallery 图像成为很多不同身份 query 的误吸附点(negative in-degree hub)。** ReID 不是独立 pair matching, 是 directed kNN graph retrieval; 隐藏变量 = gallery 的负向 in-degree, 不是 hard-negative distance(hard 对一个 anchor 近; hub 对很多不同身份都近)。

./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pscjepa_diagnosis.md:2391:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6159:Strong supervised ReID is often treated as "solved" on Market (94+ mAP). Yet a residual of queries fail even with state-of-the-art backbones. The dominant framing treats each failure as an isolated **pairwise** problem—this query's feature is not close enough to its gallery match. We argue the residual failure is better understood as a **directed kNN-graph** property of the gallery: **a few gallery images become attraction hubs for many queries of unrelated identities** (many-to-one). The hidden variable is the gallery's **negative in-degree**, distinct from hard-negative distance (hard = close to *one* anchor; hub = close to *many different identities*).
./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_pscjepa_diagnosis.md:2392:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:6214:强 ReID(Swin/SOLIDER, Market 94.6 / Occluded-Duke 73)仍有残差失败。大家默认失败来自"某个 query 没匹配好"(pairwise similarity 病)。**重定义: 强 ReID 的残差失败是 gallery topology 的 many-to-one 吸附——少数 gallery 图像成为很多不同身份 query 的误吸附点(negative in-degree hub)。** ReID 不是独立 pair matching, 是 directed kNN graph retrieval; 隐藏变量 = gallery 的负向 in-degree, 不是 hard-negative distance(hard 对一个 anchor 近; hub 对很多不同身份都近)。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_16.md:289:**候选二裁决(主序列, 详 results.md exp029 + 决策#52 执行结果)**: 判负。复现校验过(v0 Market 87.01=训练日志)。Market 陈旧索引: mAP 阶梯非单调(g=v0 51.74>g=v2 50.85,是 v0 作为 Market 专家的质量混淆,非版本年龄递减); 真正大效应是"混版本图库" −21mAP,而同质旧版本单独可用(g=v0 51.74)→ 这是经典 BCT/C2R/Hot-refresh 不兼容悬崖(那条线的立项动机),不是新的可利用版本年龄结构。候选二作为新方法线判负。hyy 独立序列(Market→OccPoseTrack→OccDuke)跑完确认稳健性。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:824:./reviews/deep_7.md:6983:1. 触发观察：作者先观察训练过程中“特征向量范数”和准确率的关系。随着训练推进，特征范数下降，准确率上升；Market-1501 前 30 个 epoch 里 rank-1 下降时，特征范数反而上升。这个观察把一个很普通的 loss 设计问题，变成了“训练动态里范数压缩不稳定”的问题。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2097:./ondisk_pivot.md:2783:./debate/d_2.md:25:角色=**蓝队(降级 Hubness)**。为'别投训练, 降级转 r_2 备胎 Rank-Instability'辩护: D2 是铁证——k-reciprocal/camera **免费 test-time** 就在 mAP 上赢, 一个训练版要 beat camera-aware k-reciprocal 是高 bar 且小 headroom(Market 饱和)。用联网查: (a)hubness-aware training / anti-hub margin 历史上是否真能 beat 强 re-ranking(还是总被 k-reciprocal 这类盖过); (b)R1 赢 mAP 输是不是只是把 ranking 重排没真增加判别信息; (c)团队反复投不确定训练的教训。论证'诊断真≠方法能发', 该把诊断当一个 observation 写进别的稿/换 r_2。信心 1-10。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2099:./ondisk_pivot.md:2790:./debate/d_2.md:79:蓝队理由很硬：你的 D4 证明的是“Gallery negative hubness 是真实失败结构”，但 D2 证明的是“当前可落地方法入口不够强”。这两件事不能混在一起。零训练 `cos - λlog(1+H_k)` 在 Market 只给 `+0.31 mAP`，而 k-reciprocal `+1.26 mAP`、camera downweight `+0.67 mAP` 都是免费 test-time。训练版如果要成为 CCF-B 方法稿，不能只赢 raw cosine，至少要在 mAP 上打过这些便宜强基线，否则审稿人会说：你发现了 hubness，但有效解法还是 re-ranking/camera prior。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4424:./debate/d_2.md:88:   k-reciprocal re-ranking 本来就是 ReID 图库拓扑修正：无标注、无训练、对任意初始排序可用；原论文在 Market/MARS/CUHK03/PRW 上展示大 mAP 增益，例如 IDE(R)+KISSME 在 Market 上 mAP 从 49.05 到 63.63，论文自己强调 mAP 提升显著。你的 hub score 本质也是图库图结构惩罚，但零训练 mAP 被 k-reciprocal 覆盖，这直接把训练版的证明门槛抬高。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4455:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:578:4. **证据闭环**：最关键的消融是和 KNN、相似度阈值、MPLP 比。Market 上相似度阈值是 72.8 Rank-1、39.9 mAP，MPRD 到 83.0、51.1。去掉大量无标签数据训练 GCN 的版本只有 75.8、43.1，说明不是 metadata 本身撑起来的。t-SNE 里加 GCN 后同身份更聚、易混身份分开，直接对应“邻域关系比点对相似度更可靠”。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4497:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1706:1. 触发观察：作者先观察训练过程中“特征向量范数”和准确率的关系。随着训练推进，特征范数下降，准确率上升；Market-1501 前 30 个 epoch 里 rank-1 下降时，特征范数反而上升。这个观察把一个很普通的 loss 设计问题，变成了“训练动态里范数压缩不稳定”的问题。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4499:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1760:4. 证据闭环：Fig.1 的 corruption t-SNE 是重定义的根证据。四种协议 Clean Eval、Corrupt Eval、Corrupt Query、Corrupt Gallery 证明作者没有只测一种有利场景。Market-1501 的 Corrupt Eval 相对 baseline 有大幅提升，mINP 从 18.48 到 32.96，mAP 从 56.36 到 69.74，Rank-1 从 75.86 到 85.68。Clean Eval 略降反而支撑了作者说法：对齐会牺牲部分干净域特定信息，但换来 corruption-invariant 表征。

./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4765:./debate/clean/d_2.txt:3:蓝队理由很硬：你的 D4 证明的是“Gallery negative hubness 是真实失败结构”，但 D2 证明的是“当前可落地方法入口不够强”。这两件事不能混在一起。零训练 `cos - λlog(1+H_k)` 在 Market 只给 `+0.31 mAP`，而 k-reciprocal `+1.26 mAP`、camera downweight `+0.67 mAP` 都是免费 test-time。训练版如果要成为 CCF-B 方法稿，不能只赢 raw cosine，至少要在 mAP 上打过这些便宜强基线，否则审稿人会说：你发现了 hubness，但有效解法还是 re-ranking/camera prior。
./experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4767:./debate/clean/d_2.txt:12:   k-reciprocal re-ranking 本来就是 ReID 图库拓扑修正：无标注、无训练、对任意初始排序可用；原论文在 Market/MARS/CUHK03/PRW 上展示大 mAP 增益，例如 IDE(R)+KISSME 在 Market 上 mAP 从 49.05 到 63.63，论文自己强调 mAP 提升显著。你的 hub score 本质也是图库图结构惩罚，但零训练 mAP 被 k-reciprocal 覆盖，这直接把训练版的证明门槛抬高。
